seg.6a61d0d1cb9e.src: Chimmili for Nagula Chavithi ⟦1⟧(Sesame Jaggery Balls)⟦/1⟧

seg.4fea7db714b7.src: Chimmili is a small Telugu sweet of roasted sesame and jaggery, ground coarsely and rolled into balls. It is one of the offerings made on Nagula Chavithi in Karthika masam, along with chalimidi and the milk poured at the snake anthill (putta). Sesame and jaggery sweets like it are made again at Sankranti.
seg.4fea7db714b7.t: চিম্মিলি তেলুগু লোকৰ এবিধ সৰু মিঠাই: ভজা তিল আৰু গুড় মোটাকৈ গুড়ি কৰি লাড়ু বনোৱা হয়। কাৰ্তিক মাহত নাগুলা চৱিতিৰ দিনা যিবোৰ আগবঢ়োৱা হয়, এইটো তাৰে এটা, লগত থাকে চালিমিডি আৰু সাপৰ হাফলুত (পুট্টা) ঢালি দিয়া গাখীৰ। সংক্ৰান্তিতো এনে তিল-গুড়ৰ মিঠাই আকৌ বনোৱা হয়।
seg.4fea7db714b7.back: Chimmili is a kind of small sweet of the Telugu people: roasted sesame and jaggery are ground coarsely and made into laddus. It is one of the things offered on the day of Nagula Chavithi in the month of Kartika, along with chalimidi and milk poured into the snake's anthill (putta). At Sankranti too, such sesame-jaggery sweets are made again.

seg.6e104d560e56.src: Roasted sesame gives it a nutty, toasty taste, and cane jaggery a caramel sweetness. The texture is soft and a little crumbly, and each ball is gone in two bites. This recipe makes about 12.
seg.6e104d560e56.t: ভজা তিলে বাদামৰ দৰে, ভজা ভজা সোৱাদ দিয়ে, আৰু কুঁহিয়াৰৰ গুড়ে কেৰামেলৰ দৰে মিঠা সোৱাদ। খাওঁতে কোমল আৰু অলপ গুড়ি গুড়ি হৈ যোৱা, প্ৰতিটো লাড়ু দুই কামোৰতে শেষ। এই ৰেচিপিত প্ৰায় 12টা হয়।
seg.6e104d560e56.back: Roasted sesame gives a nutty, toasty taste, and sugarcane jaggery a caramel-like sweet taste. Soft and a little crumbly to eat, each laddu is finished in two bites. This recipe makes about 12.

seg.2097a0e593c6.src: Make chimmili at home: roast sesame till it crackles, grind coarsely, pulse with grated cane jaggery and cardamom, shape into balls.
seg.2097a0e593c6.t: ঘৰতে চিম্মিলি বনাওক: তিল চিৰচিৰ শব্দ নকৰালৈকে ভাজক, মোটাকৈ গুড়ি কৰক, খুৰুচা কুঁহিয়াৰৰ গুড় আৰু ইলাচি দি মিক্সিত অলপ অলপকৈ ঘূৰাই লওক, তাৰ পিছত লাড়ু বান্ধক।
seg.2097a0e593c6.back: Make chimmili at home: roast the sesame until it makes a crackling sound, grind it coarsely, pulse it little by little in the mixie with grated sugarcane jaggery and cardamom, then shape into laddus.

seg.ed775cba4fcf.src: Grate the jaggery and measure out the sesame before you start; once the sesame is roasted, the rest moves quickly.
seg.ed775cba4fcf.t: আৰম্ভ কৰাৰ আগতে গুড় খুৰুচি লওক আৰু তিল জুখি ৰাখক; তিল ভজা হৈ গ’লে বাকী কাম সোনকালে আগবাঢ়ে।
seg.ed775cba4fcf.back: Before starting, grate the jaggery and keep the sesame measured; once the sesame is roasted, the rest of the work moves quickly.

seg.cfb9d281b47f.src: Heat a heavy kadai or pan on low heat for a minute. Add the sesame; no oil or ghee is needed.
seg.cfb9d281b47f.t: এখন গধুৰ কেৰাহী বা পেন কম জুইত এক মিনিট গৰম কৰক। তিল দিয়ক; তেল বা ঘিঁউৰ প্ৰয়োজন নাই।
seg.cfb9d281b47f.back: Heat a heavy kadai or pan on low heat for one minute. Add the sesame; there is no need for oil or ghee.

seg.89a51ce5355c.src: Dry-roast the sesame on a low flame till it crackles and turns light golden. Stir all the time; the seeds start to pop and smell nutty after 4–6 minutes. Do not let them turn brown.
seg.89a51ce5355c.t: কম জুইত তিল শুকানকৈ ভাজক, যেতিয়ালৈকে চিৰচিৰ শব্দ নকৰে আৰু পাতল সোণালী ৰং নধৰে। সদায় লৰাই থাকক; 4–6 মিনিটৰ পিছত গুটিবোৰ ফুটিবলৈ ধৰিব আৰু বাদামৰ দৰে গোন্ধ ওলাব। মুগা ৰঙৰ হ’বলৈ নিদিব।
seg.89a51ce5355c.back: Dry-roast the sesame on low heat, until it makes a crackling sound and takes on a light golden colour. Keep stirring all the time; after 4–6 minutes the seeds will start to pop and a nutty smell will come out. Do not let it become brown (muga-coloured).

seg.999792547560.src: Tip the sesame onto a wide plate straight away so it stops browning. Cool it for about 5 minutes, until it is just warm to the touch.
seg.999792547560.t: লগে লগে তিলখিনি এখন বহল থালত ঢালি দিয়ক, যাতে ৰং আৰু গাঢ় নহয়। প্ৰায় 5 মিনিট চেঁচা হ’বলৈ দিয়ক, যেতিয়ালৈকে চুলে অলপহে গৰম লাগে।
seg.999792547560.back: Immediately pour the sesame onto a wide plate, so the colour does not get darker. Let it cool for about 5 minutes, until it feels only a little warm to the touch.

seg.77b614ea2f92.src: Grind the sesame coarsely in short pulses. Use the small jar of the mixer and pulse 3–4 times, a second or two at a time; stop while you can still see broken seeds.
seg.77b614ea2f92.t: অলপ অলপকৈ ঘূৰাই তিল মোটাকৈ গুড়ি কৰক। মিক্সিৰ সৰু জাৰটো লওক আৰু 3–4 বাৰ ঘূৰাওক, প্ৰতিবাৰ এক-দুই ছেকেণ্ডকৈ; ভঙা গুটি দেখি থাকোঁতেই ৰখক।
seg.77b614ea2f92.back: Grind the sesame coarsely by pulsing little by little. Take the small jar of the mixie and pulse 3–4 times, one or two seconds each time; stop while you are seeing broken seeds.

seg.175aeced5810.src: Add the jaggery and cardamom; pulse till it comes together. This takes 4–6 more short pulses; scrape down the sides once. A pinch pressed between your fingers should hold its shape.
seg.175aeced5810.t: গুড় আৰু ইলাচি দিয়ক; একেলগে লগ নলগালৈকে ঘূৰাওক। ইয়াৰ বাবে আৰু 4–6 বাৰ অলপকৈ ঘূৰাব লাগে; মাজতে এবাৰ জাৰৰ কাষৰ পৰা চেঁচি নমাই দিয়ক। আঙুলিৰে এচিমটি হেঁচিলে আকাৰ ধৰি ৰাখিব লাগে।
seg.175aeced5810.back: Add the jaggery and cardamom; pulse until it sticks together. This needs another 4–6 short pulses; once in between, scrape it down from the side of the jar. When a pinch is pressed with the fingers, it should hold its shape.

seg.6f94cb46b9ab.src: If the mixture is too dry to hold, add 1–2 tsp more grated jaggery and pulse once or twice again.
seg.6f94cb46b9ab.t: মিশ্ৰণটো বেছি শুকান হৈ লগ নলগা হ’লে আৰু 1–2 চাহ চামুচ খুৰুচা গুড় দি আকৌ এবাৰ-দুবাৰ ঘূৰাওক।
seg.6f94cb46b9ab.back: If the mixture is too dry and does not stick together, add 1–2 more teaspoons of grated jaggery and pulse again once or twice.

seg.226f137c9449.src: Tip the mixture into a bowl and grease your palms lightly with ghee.
seg.226f137c9449.t: মিশ্ৰণটো এটা বাটিত ঢালি লওক আৰু হাতৰ তলুৱাত অলপ ঘিঁউ সানি লওক।
seg.226f137c9449.back: Pour the mixture into a bowl and rub a little ghee on your palms.

seg.ff3eb71729c2.src: Shape into small balls. Take a heaped tablespoon at a time, press it firmly in your fist, then roll it smooth. Work quickly while the mixture is still warm, as it turns crumbly when it cools.
seg.ff3eb71729c2.t: সৰু সৰু লাড়ু বান্ধক। এবাৰত এক ডাঙৰ চামুচ ভৰাই লওক, মুঠিত টানকৈ হেঁচক, তাৰ পিছত ঘূৰাই মসৃণ কৰক। মিশ্ৰণ গৰম থাকোঁতেই সোনকালে কাম কৰক, কিয়নো চেঁচা হ’লে গুড়ি গুড়ি হৈ যায়।
seg.ff3eb71729c2.back: Shape small laddus. Fill one tablespoon at a time, press it tightly in your fist, then roll it smooth. Work quickly while the mixture is warm, because when it cools it becomes crumbly.

seg.ee9e027268aa.src: Leave the balls on a plate until they cool completely, about 15 minutes, then store them in an airtight jar.
seg.ee9e027268aa.t: লাড়ুবোৰ এখন থালত ৰাখি দিয়ক যেতিয়ালৈকে সম্পূৰ্ণ চেঁচা নহয়, প্ৰায় 15 মিনিট, তাৰ পিছত বতাহ নোসোমোৱা বটলত ভৰাই ৰাখক।
seg.ee9e027268aa.back: Keep the laddus on a plate until they are completely cool, about 15 minutes, then fill them into an airtight bottle and keep.

seg.7fe633314020.src: Roast on a low flame and keep stirring; sesame goes from golden to burnt quickly, and burnt sesame tastes bitter.
seg.7fe633314020.t: কম জুইত ভাজক আৰু লৰাই থাকক; তিল সোণালীৰ পৰা বৰ সোনকালে পুৰি যায়, আৰু পোৰা তিল তিতা লাগে।
seg.7fe633314020.back: Roast on low heat and keep stirring; sesame burns very quickly from golden, and burnt sesame tastes bitter.

seg.d50b37351252.src: Grind in short pulses only; long runs turn sesame into an oily paste.
seg.d50b37351252.t: কেৱল অলপ অলপকৈ ঘূৰাওক; একেলেথাৰিয়ে ঘূৰালে তিল তেলীয়া লেপ হৈ যায়।
seg.d50b37351252.back: Only pulse little by little; if you grind continuously, the sesame becomes an oily paste.

seg.75f5428655c4.src: Shape while the mixture is warm. If it turns crumbly, pulse it once more with a teaspoon of grated jaggery.
seg.75f5428655c4.t: মিশ্ৰণ গৰম থাকোঁতেই আকাৰ দিয়ক। গুড়ি গুড়ি হৈ গ’লে এক চাহ চামুচ খুৰুচা গুড় দি আৰু এবাৰ ঘূৰাওক।
seg.75f5428655c4.back: Shape while the mixture is warm. If it has become crumbly, add one teaspoon of grated jaggery and pulse once more.

seg.1d42a24453d2.src: Soft jaggery binds best. If yours is hard, grate it finely so it blends in evenly.
seg.1d42a24453d2.t: কোমল গুড়ে আটাইতকৈ ভালকৈ লগ লগায়। আপোনাৰ গুড় টান হ’লে মিহিকৈ খুৰুচি লওক, যাতে সমানে মিহলি যায়।
seg.1d42a24453d2.back: Soft jaggery binds best. If your jaggery is hard, grate it finely, so that it mixes evenly.

seg.5a7ed16f4810.src: Palm jaggery: use the same amount of grated palm jaggery for darker chimmili with a smoky sweetness.
seg.5a7ed16f4810.t: তালৰ গুড়: একে পৰিমাণৰ খুৰুচা তালৰ গুড় দিয়ক, চিম্মিলি হ’ব অধিক গাঢ় ৰঙৰ, মিঠাত অলপ ধোঁৱাৰ দৰে সোৱাদ।
seg.5a7ed16f4810.back: Palm jaggery: add the same amount of grated palm jaggery; the chimmili will be darker in colour, with a slightly smoke-like taste in the sweetness.

seg.569a63f3cd17.src: Black sesame (nalla nuvvulu): roast and grind it the same way for darker, stronger-tasting balls.
seg.569a63f3cd17.t: ক’লা তিল (নাল্লা নুৱ্ৱুলু): একে দৰে ভাজি গুড়ি কৰক, লাড়ু হ’ব অধিক গাঢ় ৰঙৰ আৰু সোৱাদ হ’ব কড়া।
seg.569a63f3cd17.back: Black sesame (nalla nuvvulu): roast and grind the same way; the laddus will be darker in colour and the taste will be strong.

seg.da0d1a9b6378.src: Peanut or coconut: pulse in 2 tbsp roasted peanuts or grated dry coconut with the jaggery.
seg.da0d1a9b6378.t: মাটিমাহ বা নাৰিকল: গুড়ৰ লগত 2 ডাঙৰ চামুচ ভজা মাটিমাহ বা খুৰুচা শুকান নাৰিকল দি ঘূৰাই লওক।
seg.da0d1a9b6378.back: Peanuts or coconut: add 2 tablespoons of roasted peanuts or grated dry coconut with the jaggery and pulse.

seg.32d41fc0994e.src: Without a mixer: pound the warm sesame and jaggery together in a stone mortar (rolu) until the mixture holds, then shape.
seg.32d41fc0994e.t: মিক্সি নাথাকিলে: গৰম তিল আৰু গুড় একেলগে শিলৰ উৰালত (ৰোলু) খুন্দক যেতিয়ালৈকে মিশ্ৰণ লগ নলগে, তাৰ পিছত আকাৰ দিয়ক।
seg.32d41fc0994e.back: If there is no mixie: pound the warm sesame and jaggery together in a stone mortar (rolu) until the mixture sticks together, then shape.

seg.2fa9aaef4425.src: On Nagula Chavithi morning, offer chimmili with milk at the snake anthill (putta) or in your puja, then share them as prasadam. They also go well with evening tea.
seg.2fa9aaef4425.t: নাগুলা চৱিতিৰ ৰাতিপুৱা সাপৰ হাফলুত (পুট্টা) বা আপোনাৰ পূজাত গাখীৰৰ লগত চিম্মিলি আগবঢ়াওক, তাৰ পিছত প্ৰসাদ হিচাপে সকলোকে দিয়ক। গধূলিৰ চাহৰ লগতো ভাল লাগে।
seg.2fa9aaef4425.back: On the morning of Nagula Chavithi, offer the chimmili with milk at the snake's anthill (putta) or at your puja, then give it to everyone as prasad. It is also nice with evening tea.

seg.bd50831bbb3f.src: Keeps a week in an airtight jar. Store the jar at room temperature, in a dry place.
seg.bd50831bbb3f.t: বতাহ নোসোমোৱা বটলত এসপ্তাহ ভাল থাকে। বটলটো কোঠাৰ উষ্ণতাত, শুকান ঠাইত ৰাখক।
seg.bd50831bbb3f.back: Keeps well for one week in an airtight bottle. Keep the bottle at room temperature, in a dry place.

seg.4023b0de08bd.src: Why is my chimmili not holding together?
seg.4023b0de08bd.back: Why does my chimmili not stick together?

seg.7fed90d1ebe0.src: The sesame may be under-ground, or the mixture may have cooled. Pulse it once more with 1–2 tsp extra grated jaggery and shape it while it is still warm.
seg.7fed90d1ebe0.t: হয়তো তিল ভালদৰে গুড়ি হোৱা নাই, বা মিশ্ৰণ চেঁচা হৈ গৈছে। আৰু 1–2 চাহ চামুচ খুৰুচা গুড় দি আৰু এবাৰ ঘূৰাওক আৰু গৰম থাকোঁতেই আকাৰ দিয়ক।
seg.7fed90d1ebe0.back: Perhaps the sesame has not been ground well, or the mixture has gone cold. Add 1–2 more teaspoons of grated jaggery, pulse once more and shape while it is still warm.

seg.694d2b416f39.src: Why does my chimmili taste bitter?
seg.694d2b416f39.back: Why does my chimmili taste bitter?

seg.d0ee77d0957e.src: The sesame was roasted too dark. Roast it on a low flame only until it crackles and turns light golden, then tip it onto a plate at once so it stops browning.
seg.d0ee77d0957e.t: তিল বেছি গাঢ় কৰি ভজা হৈছে। কম জুইত কেৱল চিৰচিৰ শব্দ কৰা আৰু পাতল সোণালী হোৱালৈকে ভাজক, তাৰ পিছত লগে লগে থালত ঢালি দিয়ক যাতে ৰং আৰু গাঢ় নহয়।
seg.d0ee77d0957e.back: The sesame has been roasted too dark. On low heat, roast only until it makes a crackling sound and turns light golden, then immediately pour it onto a plate so the colour does not get darker.

seg.30d31a37acfa.src: Can I use palm jaggery instead of cane jaggery?
seg.30d31a37acfa.t: কুঁহিয়াৰৰ গুড়ৰ সলনি তালৰ গুড় দিব পাৰিনে?
seg.30d31a37acfa.back: Can palm jaggery be added instead of sugarcane jaggery?

seg.77afe99f558c.src: Yes. Use the same amount of grated palm jaggery (thati bellam). The chimmili will be darker, with a deeper, slightly smoky sweetness.
seg.77afe99f558c.t: পাৰে। একে পৰিমাণৰ খুৰুচা তালৰ গুড় (তাটি বেল্লাম) দিয়ক। চিম্মিলি হ’ব অধিক গাঢ় ৰঙৰ, মিঠা সোৱাদ অধিক গভীৰ, অলপ ধোঁৱাৰ দৰে।
seg.77afe99f558c.back: You can. Add the same amount of grated palm jaggery (tati bellam). The chimmili will be darker in colour, the sweet taste deeper, a little smoke-like.

seg.4b090c2ce3d3.src: Filter coffee is how many Telugu homes start the day: a strong decoction dripped through a steel filter, topped up with hot milk and frothed between a tumbler and davara. This version is sweetened with grated palm jaggery (thati bellam) in place of sugar.
seg.4b090c2ce3d3.t: বহু তেলুগু ঘৰত দিনটো আৰম্ভ হয় ফিল্টাৰ কফিৰে: ষ্টীলৰ ফিল্টাৰেদি টোপাল টোপালকৈ পৰা কড়া ডিকক্‌চন, তাত গৰম গাখীৰ মিহলাই টাম্বলাৰ আৰু দাৱৰাৰ মাজত ঢালি ঢালি ফেন তোলা হয়। ইয়াত চেনিৰ সলনি খুৰুচা তালৰ গুড় (তাটি বেল্লাম) দি মিঠা কৰা হৈছে।
seg.4b090c2ce3d3.back: In many Telugu homes the day starts with filter coffee: a strong decoction falling drop by drop through a steel filter, mixed with hot milk and frothed by pouring back and forth between a tumbler and a dabara. Here it has been sweetened with grated palm jaggery (tati bellam) instead of sugar.

seg.cff6d2079da1.src: Palm jaggery gives the cup a deep, slightly smoky caramel sweetness that sits well with the bitterness of the decoction. Once the decoction is ready it takes about 5 minutes, and it suits a slow morning as much as an evening break.
seg.cff6d2079da1.t: তালৰ গুড়ে কাপটোত গভীৰ, অলপ ধোঁৱাৰ দৰে কেৰামেলৰ মিঠা সোৱাদ আনে, যি ডিকক্‌চনৰ তিতা ভাৱৰ লগত ভালকৈ খাপ খায়। ডিকক্‌চন সাজু থাকিলে প্ৰায় 5 মিনিট লাগে, আৰু লাহে লাহে কটোৱা ৰাতিপুৱাৰ বাবে যেনেকৈ, গধূলিৰ জিৰণিৰ বাবেও তেনেকৈ ভাল।
seg.cff6d2079da1.back: Palm jaggery brings to the cup a deep, slightly smoke-like caramel sweet taste, which fits well with the bitter note of the decoction. If the decoction is ready it takes about 5 minutes, and it is as good for a slowly spent morning as for an evening rest.

seg.814efc526088.src: 5 minutes if your decoction is already made.
seg.814efc526088.back: 5 minutes if the decoction is ready beforehand.

seg.9ad0a1e24d76.src: Boil the milk, add it to the decoction, then stir in grated palm jaggery off the heat. Froth it between tumbler and davara.
seg.9ad0a1e24d76.t: গাখীৰ উতলাই ডিকক্‌চনত মিহলাওক, তাৰ পিছত জুইৰ পৰা নমাই খুৰুচা তালৰ গুড় লৰাই মিহলাই দিয়ক। টাম্বলাৰ আৰু দাৱৰাৰ মাজত ঢালি ফেন তোলক।
seg.9ad0a1e24d76.back: Boil the milk and mix it into the decoction, then take it off the heat and stir in the grated palm jaggery. Pour between the tumbler and dabara to raise froth.

seg.927b924ff51d.src: 2 tbsp filter coffee powder ⟦1⟧enough decoction for 2–3 cups⟦/1⟧
seg.927b924ff51d.t: 2 ডাঙৰ চামুচ ফিল্টাৰ কফি গুড়ি ⟦1⟧2–3 কাপৰ মান ডিকক্‌চন হয়⟦/1⟧
seg.927b924ff51d.back: 2 tablespoons filter coffee powder ⟦1⟧makes about 2–3 cups of decoction⟦/1⟧

seg.8aa60818ccf8.t: ½ কাপ পানী, সদ্য উতলি থমা
seg.8aa60818ccf8.back: ½ cup water, just stopped boiling

seg.95409b9d346e.src: 2 tbsp filter coffee decoction ⟦1⟧from above; 3 tbsp for a stronger cup⟦/1⟧
seg.95409b9d346e.t: 2 ডাঙৰ চামুচ ফিল্টাৰ কফিৰ ডিকক্‌চন ⟦1⟧ওপৰত বনোৱাটো; কড়া কাপৰ বাবে 3 ডাঙৰ চামুচ⟦/1⟧
seg.95409b9d346e.back: 2 tablespoons filter coffee decoction ⟦1⟧the one made above; 3 tablespoons for a strong cup⟦/1⟧

seg.7b8c0f7e922a.t: 1–2 চাহ চামুচ খুৰুচা তালৰ গুড় ⟦1⟧সোৱাদ অনুসৰি⟦/1⟧
seg.7b8c0f7e922a.back: 1–2 teaspoons grated palm jaggery ⟦1⟧according to taste⟦/1⟧

seg.95d91fecafcb.src: Make the decoction: put 2 tbsp filter coffee powder in the top chamber of a South Indian coffee filter, set the perforated press on it and pour in ½ cup water just off the boil. Cover and leave it to drip for 10–15 minutes.
seg.95d91fecafcb.t: ডিকক্‌চন বনাওক: দক্ষিণ ভাৰতীয় কফি ফিল্টাৰৰ ওপৰৰ খোপত 2 ডাঙৰ চামুচ ফিল্টাৰ কফি গুড়ি দিয়ক, তাৰ ওপৰত ফুটা থকা প্ৰেছটো বহুৱাই সদ্য উতলি থমা ½ কাপ পানী ঢালক। ঢাকি 10–15 মিনিট টোপাল টোপালকৈ পৰিবলৈ দিয়ক।
seg.95d91fecafcb.back: Make the decoction: put 2 tablespoons of filter coffee powder in the upper compartment of a South Indian coffee filter, set the press with holes on top of it and pour ½ cup of water that has just stopped boiling. Cover and let it fall drop by drop for 10–15 minutes.

seg.9024c8716b54.src: While it drips, grate the palm jaggery finely so it dissolves in seconds.
seg.9024c8716b54.t: ডিকক্‌চন পৰি থাকোঁতে তালৰ গুড় মিহিকৈ খুৰুচি লওক, যাতে কেই ছেকেণ্ডমানতে গলি যায়।
seg.9024c8716b54.back: While the decoction is dripping, grate the palm jaggery finely, so that it melts within a few seconds.

seg.24689e3dd311.src: Pour the milk into a small saucepan and set it on medium heat.
seg.24689e3dd311.t: এটা সৰু চচপেনত গাখীৰ ঢালি মধ্যমীয়া জুইত বহুৱাওক।
seg.24689e3dd311.back: Pour the milk into a small saucepan and set it on medium heat.

seg.4d8e3042dc81.src: Bring the milk to a boil. As soon as it froths up the sides of the pan, switch off the heat.
seg.4d8e3042dc81.t: গাখীৰ উতলাওক। ফেন উঠি চচপেনৰ কাষেদি ওপৰলৈ উঠিবলৈ ধৰিলেই জুই বন্ধ কৰক।
seg.4d8e3042dc81.back: Boil the milk. As soon as the froth rises and starts climbing up the side of the saucepan, turn off the heat.

seg.a124a0d34983.src: Pour the decoction into a tumbler and add the hot milk. Use 2 tbsp decoction for a mild cup and 3 tbsp for a strong one.
seg.a124a0d34983.t: টাম্বলাৰত ডিকক্‌চন ঢালক আৰু গৰম গাখীৰ মিহলাওক। পাতল কাপৰ বাবে 2 ডাঙৰ চামুচ ডিকক্‌চন, কড়া কাপৰ বাবে 3 ডাঙৰ চামুচ।
seg.a124a0d34983.back: Pour the decoction into the tumbler and mix in the hot milk. 2 tablespoons of decoction for a light cup, 3 tablespoons for a strong cup.

seg.85570720618b.src: Let it stand for about a minute, so the milk is just off the boil.
seg.85570720618b.t: প্ৰায় এক মিনিট ৰাখি দিয়ক, যাতে গাখীৰৰ উতলা মাত্ৰ থমে।
seg.85570720618b.back: Leave it for about one minute, so that the milk's boiling just stops.

seg.eacea0d7cf43.src: Stir in the palm jaggery off the heat. Keep stirring for 20–30 seconds, until no grains are left at the bottom of the tumbler.
seg.eacea0d7cf43.t: জুইৰ পৰা আঁতৰাই তালৰ গুড় লৰাই মিহলাওক। 20–30 ছেকেণ্ড লৰাই থাকক, যেতিয়ালৈকে টাম্বলাৰৰ তলিত এটাও গুটি নাথাকে।
seg.eacea0d7cf43.back: Moving it away from the heat, stir in the palm jaggery. Keep stirring for 20–30 seconds, until not a single granule remains at the bottom of the tumbler.

seg.08b600da2ef8.src: Taste, and add a little more jaggery if you like it sweeter.
seg.08b600da2ef8.t: চাখি চাওক, আৰু মিঠা লাগিলে অলপ বেছি গুড় দিয়ক।
seg.08b600da2ef8.back: Taste it, and if you want it sweeter add a little more jaggery.

seg.878b0d8d7eeb.src: Pour between tumbler and davara to froth. Hold the tumbler high and pour into the davara, then back again, 3–4 times, until a light foam sits on top.
seg.878b0d8d7eeb.t: ফেন তুলিবলৈ টাম্বলাৰ আৰু দাৱৰাৰ মাজত ঢালাঢালি কৰক। টাম্বলাৰটো ওখকৈ ধৰি দাৱৰাত ঢালক, তাৰ পিছত আকৌ উভতাই ঢালক, 3–4 বাৰ, যেতিয়ালৈকে ওপৰত পাতল ফেন নজমে।
seg.878b0d8d7eeb.back: To raise froth, pour back and forth between the tumbler and the dabara. Hold the tumbler high and pour into the dabara, then pour it back again, 3–4 times, until a light froth forms on top.

seg.653390b95f57.src: Serve straight away, in the tumbler set inside the davara.
seg.653390b95f57.t: লগে লগে পৰিৱেশন কৰক, দাৱৰাৰ ভিতৰত টাম্বলাৰটো বহুৱাই।
seg.653390b95f57.back: Serve immediately, with the tumbler set inside the dabara.

seg.33aca43ebf99.src: Add jaggery after the milk is off the boil so it does not split.
seg.33aca43ebf99.t: গাখীৰৰ উতলা থমাৰ পিছতহে গুড় দিয়ক, যাতে গাখীৰ ফাটি নাযায়।
seg.33aca43ebf99.back: Add the jaggery only after the milk's boiling stops, so that the milk does not split.

seg.60404da43771.src: Grate the jaggery finely: fine shreds dissolve in seconds, while lumps sink and stay at the bottom of the tumbler.
seg.60404da43771.t: গুড় মিহিকৈ খুৰুচি লওক: মিহি টুকুৰা কেই ছেকেণ্ডমানতে গলি যায়, কিন্তু দলা থাকিলে টাম্বলাৰৰ তলিত বহি থাকে।
seg.60404da43771.back: Grate the jaggery finely: fine pieces melt within a few seconds, but if there are lumps they stay sitting at the bottom of the tumbler.

seg.ca883342300e.src: Palm jaggery has a deep, slightly smoky sweetness, so start with 1 tsp and add more to taste.
seg.ca883342300e.t: তালৰ গুড়ৰ মিঠা সোৱাদ গভীৰ, অলপ ধোঁৱাৰ দৰে, গতিকে 1 চাহ চামুচৰে আৰম্ভ কৰক আৰু সোৱাদ অনুসৰি বঢ়াওক।
seg.ca883342300e.back: The sweet taste of palm jaggery is deep, a little smoke-like, so start with 1 teaspoon and increase according to taste.

seg.d7c0084f5cc6.src: A steel tumbler and davara keep the coffee hot and make frothing easy; a mug and a jug work too.
seg.d7c0084f5cc6.t: ষ্টীলৰ টাম্বলাৰ আৰু দাৱৰাত কফি গৰম থাকে আৰু ফেন তোলা সহজ হয়; মগ আৰু জগতো কাম চলে।
seg.d7c0084f5cc6.back: In a steel tumbler and dabara the coffee stays hot and frothing is easy; a mug and jug also work.

seg.1b917ac5fc8c.src: Cane jaggery: use the same amount of grated cane jaggery for a lighter, caramel-like sweetness.
seg.1b917ac5fc8c.t: কুঁহিয়াৰৰ গুড়: একে পৰিমাণৰ খুৰুচা কুঁহিয়াৰৰ গুড় দিয়ক, মিঠা হ’ব পাতল, কেৰামেলৰ দৰে।
seg.1b917ac5fc8c.back: Sugarcane jaggery: add the same amount of grated sugarcane jaggery; the sweetness will be light, caramel-like.

seg.0ada954bebfe.src: Palm jaggery tea: make your usual milk tea, switch off the heat, wait a minute, then stir in the palm jaggery the same way.
seg.0ada954bebfe.t: তালৰ গুড়ৰ চাহ: সদায় বনোৱাৰ দৰে গাখীৰ চাহ বনাওক, জুই বন্ধ কৰি এক মিনিট অপেক্ষা কৰক, তাৰ পিছত একে দৰে তালৰ গুড় লৰাই মিহলাওক।
seg.0ada954bebfe.back: Palm jaggery tea: make milk tea as you always make it, turn off the heat and wait one minute, then stir in the palm jaggery the same way.

seg.6512d133d4c0.src: No coffee filter: dissolve 1 tsp instant coffee in 2 tbsp hot water and use it in place of the decoction.
seg.6512d133d4c0.t: কফি ফিল্টাৰ নাথাকিলে: 2 ডাঙৰ চামুচ গৰম পানীত 1 চাহ চামুচ ইনষ্টেণ্ট কফি গুলি ডিকক্‌চনৰ সলনি ব্যৱহাৰ কৰক।
seg.6512d133d4c0.back: If there is no coffee filter: dissolve 1 teaspoon of instant coffee in 2 tablespoons of hot water and use it instead of the decoction.

seg.e9e80ce83cf6.src: Serve hot after a breakfast of idli, dosa or upma, or in the evening with biscuits or murukulu.
seg.e9e80ce83cf6.t: ইডলি, দোচা বা উপমাৰ জলপানৰ পিছত গৰমে গৰমে দিয়ক, বা গধূলি বিস্কুট বা মুৰুকুলুৰ লগত।
seg.e9e80ce83cf6.back: Serve hot after a snack/breakfast of idli, dosa or upma, or in the evening with biscuits or murukulu.

seg.97817ad1f29f.src: Make each cup as you need it; coffee reheated after the jaggery goes in can split. Keep extra decoction covered at room temperature and use it within the day.
seg.97817ad1f29f.t: যেতিয়া যি কাপ লাগে তেতিয়াহে বনাওক; গুড় দিয়াৰ পিছত কফি আকৌ গৰম কৰিলে ফাটি যাব পাৰে। বাকী থকা ডিকক্‌চন ঢাকি কোঠাৰ উষ্ণতাত ৰাখক আৰু সেইদিনাৰ ভিতৰতে শেষ কৰক।
seg.97817ad1f29f.back: Make whichever cup only when it is needed; if the coffee is heated again after adding jaggery it may split. Keep the remaining decoction covered at room temperature and finish it within that same day.

seg.ea4f4072538a.src: Why did my coffee curdle when I added palm jaggery?
seg.ea4f4072538a.t: তালৰ গুড় দিয়াৰ পিছত মোৰ কফি ফাটি গ’ল কিয়?
seg.ea4f4072538a.back: Why did my coffee split after adding palm jaggery?

seg.180a2670ead3.src: Jaggery stirred into milk that is still boiling can make it split. Take the milk off the heat, let it stand for about a minute, then stir in the grated jaggery.
seg.180a2670ead3.t: উতলি থকা গাখীৰত গুড় মিহলালে গাখীৰ ফাটি যাব পাৰে। গাখীৰ জুইৰ পৰা নমাই প্ৰায় এক মিনিট ৰাখি দিয়ক, তাৰ পিছত খুৰুচা গুড় লৰাই মিহলাওক।
seg.180a2670ead3.back: If jaggery is mixed into boiling milk, the milk can split. Take the milk off the heat and leave it for about one minute, then stir in the grated jaggery.

seg.2b9449407096.src: Can I use cane jaggery instead of palm jaggery?
seg.2b9449407096.t: তালৰ গুড়ৰ সলনি কুঁহিয়াৰৰ গুড় দিব পাৰিনে?
seg.2b9449407096.back: Can sugarcane jaggery be added instead of palm jaggery?

seg.890ae3e15593.src: Yes. Use the same amount of grated cane jaggery. The coffee tastes lighter and more like caramel, while palm jaggery gives a deeper, slightly smoky cup.
seg.890ae3e15593.t: পাৰে। একে পৰিমাণৰ খুৰুচা কুঁহিয়াৰৰ গুড় দিয়ক। কফিৰ সোৱাদ হ’ব পাতল, কেৰামেলৰ দৰে, আনহাতে তালৰ গুড়ে কাপটো অধিক গভীৰ, অলপ ধোঁৱাৰ দৰে কৰে।
seg.890ae3e15593.back: You can. Add the same amount of grated sugarcane jaggery. The coffee's taste will be light, caramel-like, whereas palm jaggery makes the cup deeper, a little smoke-like.

seg.e4c92d1c8a42.src: How much palm jaggery should I add to one cup of coffee?
seg.e4c92d1c8a42.t: এক কাপ কফিত কিমান তালৰ গুড় দিম?
seg.e4c92d1c8a42.back: How much palm jaggery should I add to one cup of coffee?

seg.43a5dfb10340.src: 1 to 2 tsp of grated palm jaggery for 1 cup of milk and 2 tbsp of decoction. Start with 1 tsp, taste, and add more if you like.
seg.43a5dfb10340.t: 1 কাপ গাখীৰ আৰু 2 ডাঙৰ চামুচ ডিকক্‌চনত 1ৰ পৰা 2 চাহ চামুচ খুৰুচা তালৰ গুড়। 1 চাহ চামুচৰে আৰম্ভ কৰক, চাখি চাওক, আৰু ইচ্ছা হ’লে বেছি দিয়ক।
seg.43a5dfb10340.back: 1 to 2 teaspoons of grated palm jaggery in 1 cup of milk and 2 tablespoons of decoction. Start with 1 teaspoon, taste it, and add more if you wish.

seg.2ba4fb9452bb.src: Can I make palm jaggery coffee without a coffee filter?
seg.2ba4fb9452bb.t: কফি ফিল্টাৰ নোহোৱাকৈ তালৰ গুড়ৰ কফি বনাব পাৰিনে?
seg.2ba4fb9452bb.back: Can palm jaggery coffee be made without a coffee filter?

seg.23f63da2d908.src: Yes. Dissolve 1 tsp instant coffee in 2 tbsp hot water, use it in place of the decoction and follow the same steps.
seg.23f63da2d908.t: পাৰে। 2 ডাঙৰ চামুচ গৰম পানীত 1 চাহ চামুচ ইনষ্টেণ্ট কফি গুলি ডিকক্‌চনৰ সলনি ব্যৱহাৰ কৰক, আৰু বাকী খোজবোৰ একে।
seg.23f63da2d908.back: You can. Dissolve 1 teaspoon of instant coffee in 2 tablespoons of hot water and use it instead of the decoction, and the remaining steps are the same.

seg.4fce579abe5f.src: తాటి బెల్లం కాఫీ · Palm Jaggery Coffee Recipe | 1acrefarms
seg.4fce579abe5f.t: తాటి బెల్లం కాఫీ · তালৰ গুড়ৰ কফিৰ ৰেচিপি | 1acrefarms
seg.4fce579abe5f.back: తాటి బెల్లం కాఫీ · Palm jaggery coffee recipe | 1acrefarms

seg.08ada9e6791e.src: తాటి బెల్లం కాఫీ. Palm jaggery coffee (thati bellam coffee), the Andhra way: filter decoction, hot milk and grated palm jaggery stirred in off the heat. Step-by-step method, tips and FAQs.
seg.08ada9e6791e.t: తాటి బెల్లం కాఫీ. তালৰ গুড়ৰ কফি (তাটি বেল্লাম কফি), অন্ধ্ৰৰ ধৰণে: ফিল্টাৰৰ ডিকক্‌চন, গৰম গাখীৰ, আৰু জুইৰ পৰা নমাই মিহলোৱা খুৰুচা তালৰ গুড়। খোজে খোজে প্ৰণালী, পৰামৰ্শ আৰু প্ৰশ্নোত্তৰ।
seg.08ada9e6791e.back: తాటి బెల్లం కాఫీ. Palm jaggery coffee (tati bellam coffee), in the Andhra way: filter decoction, hot milk, and grated palm jaggery mixed in after taking it off the heat. Step-by-step method, advice and questions and answers.

seg.0fc7db27d3fc.src: Palm Jaggery Coffee: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.0fc7db27d3fc.t: তালৰ গুড়ৰ কফি: 1acrefarms-ৰ ৰেচিপি কাৰ্ড, উপকৰণ আৰু প্ৰণালীৰ সৈতে
seg.0fc7db27d3fc.back: Palm jaggery coffee: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.1143d51ba236.src: Paramannam is the rice-and-milk sweet that Telugu homes cook for festivals and pujas: rice simmered slowly in milk until soft and creamy, then sweetened. Bellam paramannam, made with jaggery, is a common naivedyam at Diwali, Sankranti and Varalakshmi Vratham, offered at the puja and then shared at the festive meal.
seg.1143d51ba236.t: পৰমান্নম হৈছে চাউল আৰু গাখীৰৰ মিঠাই, যিটো তেলুগু ঘৰত উৎসৱ আৰু পূজাত ৰন্ধা হয়: চাউল গাখীৰত লাহে লাহে উতলাই কোমল আৰু ঘন কৰা হয়, তাৰ পিছত মিঠা দিয়া হয়। গুড়েৰে বনোৱা বেল্লাম পৰমান্নম দীপাৱলী, সংক্ৰান্তি আৰু বৰলক্ষ্মী ব্ৰতমত এক চিনাকি নৈবেদ্য: পূজাত আগবঢ়াই তাৰ পিছত উৎসৱৰ ভোজত সকলোৱে মিলি খায়।
seg.1143d51ba236.back: Paramannam is a rice and milk sweet, which is cooked in Telugu homes at festivals and pujas: the rice is slowly boiled in milk and made soft and thick, then the sweetener is added. Bellam Paramannam made with jaggery is a familiar naivedyam at Deepavali, Sankranti and Varalakshmi Vratam: after offering it at the puja, everyone eats it together at the festival feast.

seg.360051f42785.src: Cane jaggery turns it a light caramel colour and gives a rounder, toffee-like sweetness. Ghee-fried cashews and a little cardamom finish it. This recipe serves 4.
seg.360051f42785.t: কুঁহিয়াৰৰ গুড়ে ইয়াৰ ৰং পাতল কেৰামেলৰ দৰে কৰে, আৰু মিঠা সোৱাদ ভৰপূৰ, টফিৰ দৰে। শেষত ঘিঁউত ভজা কাজু আৰু অলপ ইলাচি। এই ৰেচিপি 4 জনৰ বাবে।
seg.360051f42785.back: Sugarcane jaggery makes its colour light caramel-like, and the sweet taste full, toffee-like. At the end, cashews fried in ghee and a little cardamom. This recipe is for 4 people.

seg.04a51f6c83e4.src: Total includes the 5-minute rest before the jaggery goes in.
seg.04a51f6c83e4.t: মুঠ সময়ৰ ভিতৰত গুড় দিয়াৰ আগৰ 5 মিনিটৰ জিৰণিও ধৰা আছে।
seg.04a51f6c83e4.back: The total time also includes the 5-minute rest before adding the jaggery.

seg.fd8f49fce13b.src: Cook rice in milk till creamy, rest it 5 minutes, then stir in grated cane jaggery. Finish with ghee-fried cashews and cardamom.
seg.fd8f49fce13b.t: গাখীৰত চাউল ঘন নোহোৱালৈকে ৰান্ধক, 5 মিনিট ৰাখি দিয়ক, তাৰ পিছত খুৰুচা কুঁহিয়াৰৰ গুড় লৰাই মিহলাওক। শেষত ঘিঁউত ভজা কাজু আৰু ইলাচি দিয়ক।
seg.fd8f49fce13b.back: Cook the rice in milk until it becomes thick, leave it for 5 minutes, then stir in grated sugarcane jaggery. At the end add cashews fried in ghee and cardamom.

seg.1c0f194a4451.src: ½ cup rice ⟦1⟧sona masoori or another short-grain rice, about 100 g⟦/1⟧
seg.1c0f194a4451.t: ½ কাপ চাউল ⟦1⟧ছোনা মাছুৰি বা আন কোনো চুটি দানাৰ চাউল, প্ৰায় 100 g⟦/1⟧
seg.1c0f194a4451.back: ½ cup rice ⟦1⟧Sona Masuri or any other short-grain rice, about 100 g⟦/1⟧

seg.8f34922ee281.src: 4 cups milk ⟦1⟧about 1 litre; whole milk gives the creamiest result⟦/1⟧
seg.8f34922ee281.t: 4 কাপ গাখীৰ ⟦1⟧প্ৰায় 1 লিটাৰ; ফুল ক্ৰীম গাখীৰত আটাইতকৈ ঘন হয়⟦/1⟧
seg.8f34922ee281.back: 4 cups milk ⟦1⟧about 1 litre; it gets thickest with full-cream milk⟦/1⟧

seg.ee0c3b96837f.src: ¾ cup grated cane jaggery ⟦1⟧lightly packed; up to 2 tbsp more if you like it sweeter⟦/1⟧
seg.ee0c3b96837f.t: ¾ কাপ খুৰুচা কুঁহিয়াৰৰ গুড় ⟦1⟧অলপ হেঁচি জোখা; বেছি মিঠা ভাল পালে 2 ডাঙৰ চামুচলৈকে বেছি⟦/1⟧
seg.ee0c3b96837f.back: ¾ cup grated sugarcane jaggery ⟦1⟧measured lightly pressed; if you like it sweeter, up to 2 tablespoons more⟦/1⟧

seg.fa014766d2bf.src: ½ tsp cardamom powder ⟦1⟧or the crushed seeds of 4–5 pods⟦/1⟧
seg.fa014766d2bf.t: ½ চাহ চামুচ ইলাচি গুড়ি ⟦1⟧বা 4–5টা ইলাচিৰ খুন্দা গুটি⟦/1⟧
seg.fa014766d2bf.back: ½ teaspoon cardamom powder ⟦1⟧or pounded seeds of 4–5 cardamoms⟦/1⟧

seg.480e0a7d227f.src: Wash the rice in 2–3 changes of water until the water runs almost clear, then drain it well.
seg.480e0a7d227f.t: চাউল 2–3 বাৰ পানী সলাই ধুই লওক, যেতিয়ালৈকে পানী প্ৰায় পৰিষ্কাৰ নহয়, তাৰ পিছত ভালকৈ পানী নিগৰাই লওক।
seg.480e0a7d227f.back: Wash the rice 2–3 times, changing the water, until the water is almost clear, then drain the water well.

seg.d5b0fc46818a.src: Pour the milk into a heavy-bottomed pan and bring it to a boil on medium heat, about 8–10 minutes. Stir now and then so it does not catch at the bottom.
seg.d5b0fc46818a.t: গধুৰ তলিৰ পাত্ৰত গাখীৰ ঢালি মধ্যমীয়া জুইত উতলাওক, প্ৰায় 8–10 মিনিট। মাজে মাজে লৰাওক, যাতে তলিত নলগে।
seg.d5b0fc46818a.back: Pour the milk into a heavy-bottomed pot and boil it on medium heat, about 8–10 minutes. Stir now and then, so it does not stick to the bottom.

seg.b8f9c8c6758b.src: Add the drained rice to the boiling milk and turn the heat to low.
seg.b8f9c8c6758b.t: উতলি থকা গাখীৰত পানী নিগৰোৱা চাউল দিয়ক আৰু জুই কমাই দিয়ক।
seg.b8f9c8c6758b.back: Add the drained rice to the boiling milk and lower the heat.

seg.9ae9baab76d7.src: Cook the washed rice in the milk on a low flame till soft and creamy, about 30 minutes. Stir often, scraping the bottom and sides of the pan each time.
seg.9ae9baab76d7.t: ধোৱা চাউল গাখীৰত কম জুইত কোমল আৰু ঘন নোহোৱালৈকে ৰান্ধক, প্ৰায় 30 মিনিট। সঘনে লৰাওক, প্ৰতিবাৰ পাত্ৰৰ তলি আৰু কাষ চেঁচি লওক।
seg.9ae9baab76d7.back: Cook the washed rice in the milk on low heat until it becomes soft and thick, about 30 minutes. Stir frequently, each time scraping the bottom and side of the pot.

seg.ec1509a08b4c.src: Check the rice: a grain should mash easily between your fingers, and the milk should have thickened slightly. For a creamier paramannam, lightly mash a few grains against the side of the pan.
seg.ec1509a08b4c.t: চাউল চাওক: এটা দানা আঙুলিৰে হেঁচিলে সহজে পিটিকি যাব লাগে, আৰু গাখীৰ অলপ ঘন হ’ব লাগে। অধিক ঘন পৰমান্নমৰ বাবে কেইটামান দানা পাত্ৰৰ কাষত লাহেকৈ পিটিকি দিয়ক।
seg.ec1509a08b4c.back: Check the rice: a grain pressed with the fingers should squash easily, and the milk should be a little thick. For a thicker paramannam, gently squash a few grains against the side of the pot.

seg.d8ba0a82f4ec.src: Switch off and let it rest 5 minutes. This brings the milk below the boil, so the jaggery will not split it.
seg.d8ba0a82f4ec.t: জুই বন্ধ কৰি 5 মিনিট ৰাখি দিয়ক। ইয়াত গাখীৰৰ উতলা থমে, গতিকে গুড় দিলে গাখীৰ নাফাটে।
seg.d8ba0a82f4ec.back: Turn off the heat and leave it for 5 minutes. With this the milk's boiling stops, so when the jaggery is added the milk will not split.

seg.ca16c98d9b18.src: Stir in the jaggery till it melts, about 1–2 minutes, keeping the pan off the heat.
seg.ca16c98d9b18.t: পাত্ৰটো জুইৰ পৰা আঁতৰাই ৰাখি গুড় লৰাই মিহলাওক যেতিয়ালৈকে গলি নাযায়, প্ৰায় 1–2 মিনিট।
seg.ca16c98d9b18.back: Keeping the pot away from the heat, stir in the jaggery until it melts, about 1–2 minutes.

seg.74412a8cc141.src: Taste, and stir in a little more grated jaggery if you want it sweeter.
seg.74412a8cc141.t: চাখি চাওক, আৰু বেছি মিঠা লাগিলে অলপ বেছি খুৰুচা গুড় লৰাই মিহলাওক।
seg.74412a8cc141.back: Taste it, and if you want it sweeter stir in a little more grated jaggery.

seg.92b56df40ea6.src: Heat the ghee in a small pan on medium-low heat.
seg.92b56df40ea6.t: এটা সৰু পেনত মধ্যমীয়া-কম জুইত ঘিঁউ গৰম কৰক।
seg.92b56df40ea6.back: Heat the ghee in a small pan on medium-low heat.

seg.1bb1f411e4d0.src: Fry the cashews in ghee; add with the cardamom. Stir the cashews until golden, about 1 minute, adding the raisins for the last few seconds until they puff up. Pour the nuts and ghee into the paramannam, sprinkle in the cardamom powder and stir.
seg.1bb1f411e4d0.t: কাজু ঘিঁউত ভাজি ইলাচিৰ সৈতে দিয়ক। কাজু সোণালী নোহোৱালৈকে লৰাই থাকক, প্ৰায় 1 মিনিট, শেষৰ কেই ছেকেণ্ডমানত কিচমিচ দিয়ক যেতিয়ালৈকে ফুলি নুঠে। কাজু-কিচমিচ ঘিঁউৰ সৈতে পৰমান্নমত ঢালি দিয়ক, ইলাচি গুড়ি ছটিয়াই লৰাই দিয়ক।
seg.1bb1f411e4d0.back: Fry the cashews in ghee and add them with the cardamom. Keep stirring the cashews until they are golden, about 1 minute; in the last few seconds add the raisins until they puff up. Pour the cashews and raisins with the ghee into the paramannam, sprinkle the cardamom powder and stir.

seg.e10b7192c157.src: Serve warm. Paramannam thickens as it stands; loosen it with a few spoons of warm milk, off the heat, if needed.
seg.e10b7192c157.t: গৰমে গৰমে পৰিৱেশন কৰক। ৰাখি থ’লে পৰমান্নম ঘন হৈ যায়; প্ৰয়োজন হ’লে জুইৰ পৰা আঁতৰাই কেইচামুচমান গৰম গাখীৰ মিহলাই পাতল কৰি লওক।
seg.e10b7192c157.back: Serve hot. If kept, paramannam becomes thick; if needed, away from the heat, mix in a few spoons of hot milk and make it thin.

seg.d30196cf6b28.src: Jaggery goes in off the heat so the milk does not split.
seg.d30196cf6b28.t: গুড় জুইৰ পৰা নমাইহে দিয়া হয়, যাতে গাখীৰ ফাটি নাযায়।
seg.d30196cf6b28.back: The jaggery is added only after taking it off the heat, so that the milk does not split.

seg.d4a9c2ee09bf.src: Use a heavy-bottomed pan and scrape the bottom each time you stir; milk catches easily during the long simmer.
seg.d4a9c2ee09bf.t: গধুৰ তলিৰ পাত্ৰ লওক আৰু প্ৰতিবাৰ লৰাওঁতে তলি চেঁচি লওক; বহু সময় ধৰি উতলাওঁতে গাখীৰ সহজে তলিত লাগি যায়।
seg.d4a9c2ee09bf.back: Take a heavy-bottomed pot and scrape the bottom each time you stir; while boiling for a long time, milk easily sticks to the bottom.

seg.a01441abc0b6.src: Cook the rice until fully soft before the jaggery goes in; the grains do not soften further once it is sweetened.
seg.a01441abc0b6.t: গুড় দিয়াৰ আগতে চাউল সম্পূৰ্ণ কোমল হোৱালৈকে ৰান্ধক; মিঠা দিয়াৰ পিছত দানা আৰু কোমল নহয়।
seg.a01441abc0b6.back: Before adding the jaggery, cook the rice until it is completely soft; after the sweetener is added, the grains do not get softer.

seg.688b80a32383.src: Grate the jaggery finely so it melts in the hot milk without going back on the stove.
seg.688b80a32383.t: গুড় মিহিকৈ খুৰুচি লওক, যাতে আকৌ চুলাত নবহুৱাকৈ গৰম গাখীৰতে গলি যায়।
seg.688b80a32383.back: Grate the jaggery finely, so that it melts in the hot milk itself without putting it back on the stove.

seg.7bf8faca62b8.src: Palm jaggery: use the same amount of grated palm jaggery for a darker colour and a deeper, smoky sweetness.
seg.7bf8faca62b8.t: তালৰ গুড়: একে পৰিমাণৰ খুৰুচা তালৰ গুড় দিয়ক, ৰং হ’ব অধিক গাঢ় আৰু মিঠা সোৱাদ অধিক গভীৰ, ধোঁৱাৰ দৰে।
seg.7bf8faca62b8.back: Palm jaggery: add the same amount of grated palm jaggery; the colour will be darker and the sweet taste deeper, smoke-like.

seg.6672d2210281.src: Pesarapappu paramannam: dry-roast 2 tbsp split moong dal until light golden, wash it and cook it with the rice.
seg.6672d2210281.t: পেচাৰাপাপ্পু পৰমান্নম: 2 ডাঙৰ চামুচ মগুমাহ পাতল সোণালী নোহোৱালৈকে শুকানকৈ ভাজি ধুই লওক, তাৰ পিছত চাউলৰ লগত ৰান্ধক।
seg.6672d2210281.back: Pesarapappu paramannam: dry-roast 2 tablespoons of moong (mogu mah) until light golden and wash it, then cook it with the rice.

seg.cd25d9fb2a56.src: Coconut: fry 2 tbsp thin slivers of dry coconut in the ghee along with the cashews.
seg.cd25d9fb2a56.t: নাৰিকল: কাজুৰ লগতে ঘিঁউত 2 ডাঙৰ চামুচ শুকান নাৰিকলৰ পাতল ফালি ভাজি লওক।
seg.cd25d9fb2a56.back: Coconut: along with the cashews, fry 2 tablespoons of thin slices of dry coconut in ghee.

seg.988ab75b5ccb.src: Serve warm as naivedyam at the Diwali or Lakshmi puja, then as the sweet at the festive meal. Some like it chilled the next day.
seg.988ab75b5ccb.t: দীপাৱলী বা লক্ষ্মী পূজাত গৰমে গৰমে নৈবেদ্য হিচাপে দিয়ক, তাৰ পিছত উৎসৱৰ ভোজত মিঠাই হিচাপে। কিছুমানে পিছদিনা চেঁচা কৰি খাবলৈ ভাল পায়।
seg.988ab75b5ccb.back: At Deepavali or Lakshmi puja, offer it hot as naivedyam, then as a sweet at the festival feast. Some people like to eat it chilled the next day.

seg.4a60d211f14d.src: Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat within 2 days. It sets thick when chilled; stir in a little warm milk, off the heat, before serving.
seg.4a60d211f14d.t: বাকী থকা পৰমান্নম ঢাকি ফ্ৰিজত ৰাখক আৰু 2 দিনৰ ভিতৰত খাই লওক। চেঁচাত ঘন হৈ গোট মাৰে; খোৱাৰ আগতে জুইৰ পৰা আঁতৰাই অলপ গৰম গাখীৰ লৰাই মিহলাই লওক।
seg.4a60d211f14d.back: Cover the leftover paramannam and keep it in the fridge, and eat it within 2 days. In the cold it thickens and sets into a mass; before eating, away from the heat, stir in a little hot milk.

seg.2949774c7efb.src: Why did my paramannam curdle after adding jaggery?
seg.2949774c7efb.t: গুড় দিয়াৰ পিছত মোৰ পৰমান্নম ফাটি গ’ল কিয়?
seg.2949774c7efb.back: Why did my paramannam split after adding jaggery?

seg.283626ae50fc.src: Jaggery stirred into milk that is still on the heat or boiling can make it split. Switch off, let the paramannam rest for about 5 minutes, then stir in the grated jaggery.
seg.283626ae50fc.t: গাখীৰ জুইত থাকোঁতে বা উতলি থাকোঁতে গুড় মিহলালে গাখীৰ ফাটি যাব পাৰে। জুই বন্ধ কৰি পৰমান্নম প্ৰায় 5 মিনিট ৰাখি দিয়ক, তাৰ পিছত খুৰুচা গুড় লৰাই মিহলাওক।
seg.283626ae50fc.back: If jaggery is mixed in while the milk is on the heat or while it is boiling, the milk can split. Turn off the heat and leave the paramannam for about 5 minutes, then stir in the grated jaggery.

seg.7df6976d1e83.src: Yes. Use the same amount of grated palm jaggery (thati bellam). The paramannam turns darker and tastes deeper and slightly smoky.
seg.7df6976d1e83.t: পাৰে। একে পৰিমাণৰ খুৰুচা তালৰ গুড় (তাটি বেল্লাম) দিয়ক। পৰমান্নমৰ ৰং হ’ব অধিক গাঢ়, সোৱাদ অধিক গভীৰ আৰু অলপ ধোঁৱাৰ দৰে।
seg.7df6976d1e83.back: You can. Add the same amount of grated palm jaggery (tati bellam). The paramannam's colour will be darker, the taste deeper and a little smoke-like.

seg.6ac2cfc26fb7.src: Which rice is best for paramannam?
seg.6ac2cfc26fb7.t: পৰমান্নমৰ বাবে কোন চাউল আটাইতকৈ ভাল?
seg.6ac2cfc26fb7.back: Which rice is best for paramannam?

seg.ead18bc39c32.src: A short-grain rice such as sona masoori cooks soft and creamy in milk. Long-grain basmati keeps its grains separate and gives a thinner paramannam.
seg.ead18bc39c32.t: ছোনা মাছুৰিৰ দৰে চুটি দানাৰ চাউল গাখীৰত কোমল আৰু ঘনকৈ ৰন্ধা হয়। দীঘল দানাৰ বাছমতীৰ দানা বেলেগ বেলেগ হৈ থাকে, গতিকে পৰমান্নম পাতল হয়।
seg.ead18bc39c32.back: Short-grain rice like Sona Masuri cooks soft and thick in milk. The grains of long-grain basmati stay separate, so the paramannam becomes thin.

seg.2baf5cc4ec36.src: How do I fix paramannam that has become too thick?
seg.2baf5cc4ec36.t: পৰমান্নম বেছি ঘন হৈ গ’লে কি কৰিম?
seg.2baf5cc4ec36.back: What should I do if the paramannam becomes too thick?

seg.9ffeabf346fa.src: Stir in a few spoons of warm milk, off the heat, until it loosens. It thickens as it cools, so stop when it is a little thinner than you want.
seg.9ffeabf346fa.t: জুইৰ পৰা আঁতৰাই কেইচামুচমান গৰম গাখীৰ লৰাই মিহলাওক, যেতিয়ালৈকে অলপ পাতল নহয়। চেঁচা হ’লে আকৌ ঘন হয়, গতিকে আপুনি বিচৰাতকৈ অলপ পাতল থাকোঁতেই ৰখক।
seg.9ffeabf346fa.back: Away from the heat, stir in a few spoons of hot milk, until it becomes a little thin. When it cools it becomes thick again, so stop while it is a little thinner than you want.

seg.8b09026bfd65.src: బెల్లం పరమాన్నం. Bellam paramannam for Diwali: rice slow-cooked in milk and sweetened with cane jaggery off the heat, finished with ghee-fried cashews. Step-by-step method, tips and FAQs. Serves 4.
seg.8b09026bfd65.t: బెల్లం పరమాన్నం. দীপাৱলীৰ বাবে বেল্লাম পৰমান্নম: গাখীৰত লাহে লাহে ৰন্ধা চাউল, জুইৰ পৰা নমাই কুঁহিয়াৰৰ গুড়েৰে মিঠা কৰা, শেষত ঘিঁউত ভজা কাজু। খোজে খোজে প্ৰণালী, পৰামৰ্শ আৰু প্ৰশ্নোত্তৰ। 4 জনৰ বাবে।
seg.8b09026bfd65.back: బెల్లం పరమాన్నం. Bellam Paramannam for Deepavali: rice cooked slowly in milk, sweetened with sugarcane jaggery off the heat, at the end cashews fried in ghee. Step-by-step method, advice and questions and answers. For 4 people.

seg.cf8cab3618d9.src: Bellam Paramannam: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method

seg.5fbc274b0656.src: Pasupu paalu is warm milk simmered with a little turmeric and a pinch of black pepper, then sweetened with jaggery. It is an everyday cup in many Telugu homes, made on cool evenings and often through Karthika masam, the month of Somavaram (Monday) pujas and evening lamps.
seg.5fbc274b0656.t: পাচুপু পালু হৈছে গৰম গাখীৰ, তাত অলপ হালধি আৰু এচিমটি জালুক দি লাহে লাহে উতলাই গুড়েৰে মিঠা কৰা। বহু তেলুগু ঘৰত ই দৈনন্দিন এক কাপ, চেঁচা গধূলি বনোৱা হয়, আৰু প্ৰায়েই গোটেই কাৰ্তিক মাহ জুৰি, যি মাহত সোমবাৰৰ পূজা আৰু গধূলি চাকি জ্বলোৱা হয়।
seg.5fbc274b0656.back: Pasupu palu is hot milk, slowly boiled with a little turmeric and a pinch of black pepper and sweetened with jaggery. In many Telugu homes it is a daily cup, made on cold evenings, and often throughout the whole month of Kartika, the month in which Monday pujas are done and lamps are lit in the evening.

seg.7d5fe2bc79e0.src: The turmeric turns the milk golden and gives it an earthy, slightly bitter edge, the pepper adds a little heat, and the jaggery rounds it off with a caramel sweetness. This recipe makes one cup in about 5 minutes.
seg.7d5fe2bc79e0.t: হালধিয়ে গাখীৰৰ ৰং সোণালী কৰে আৰু সোৱাদত মাটিৰ দৰে, অলপ তিতা ভাৱ আনে; জালুকে অলপ জ্বলা দিয়ে, আৰু গুড়ে কেৰামেলৰ দৰে মিঠা সোৱাদেৰে সকলো মিলাই দিয়ে। এই ৰেচিপিত প্ৰায় 5 মিনিটত এক কাপ হয়।
seg.7d5fe2bc79e0.back: Turmeric makes the milk's colour golden and brings to the taste an earthy, slightly bitter note; black pepper gives a little pungent heat, and jaggery ties everything together with a caramel-like sweet taste. This recipe makes one cup in about 5 minutes.

seg.8e4df121a859.src: Simmer milk with turmeric and a pinch of pepper, switch off, then stir in a spoon of jaggery.
seg.8e4df121a859.t: গাখীৰত হালধি আৰু এচিমটি জালুক দি লাহে লাহে উতলাওক, জুই বন্ধ কৰক, তাৰ পিছত এচামুচ গুড় লৰাই মিহলাওক।
seg.8e4df121a859.back: Slowly boil the milk with turmeric and a pinch of black pepper, turn off the heat, then stir in a spoon of jaggery.

seg.33cd5776caaf.src: ¼ tsp turmeric powder ⟦1⟧Turmeric Powder or Hill Turmeric Powder⟦/1⟧
seg.33cd5776caaf.t: ¼ চাহ চামুচ হালধি গুড়ি ⟦1⟧হালধি গুড়ি বা পাহাৰী হালধি গুড়ি⟦/1⟧
seg.33cd5776caaf.back: ¼ teaspoon turmeric powder ⟦1⟧turmeric powder or hill turmeric powder⟦/1⟧

seg.f1056c625241.src: A pinch of black pepper ⟦1⟧powdered or crushed⟦/1⟧
seg.f1056c625241.back: A pinch of black pepper ⟦1⟧powdered or pounded⟦/1⟧

seg.bc417c4b3691.src: 1 tsp grated palm or cane jaggery ⟦1⟧or to taste⟦/1⟧
seg.bc417c4b3691.t: 1 চাহ চামুচ খুৰুচা তালৰ বা কুঁহিয়াৰৰ গুড় ⟦1⟧বা সোৱাদ অনুসৰি⟦/1⟧
seg.bc417c4b3691.back: 1 teaspoon grated palm or sugarcane jaggery ⟦1⟧or according to taste⟦/1⟧

seg.12c1bae1db56.back: A pinch of cardamom powder (as you wish)

seg.1a51e1f06af0.src: Sweeten it with ⟦1⟧Palm Jaggery⟦/1⟧ or ⟦2⟧Cane Jaggery⟦/2⟧.

seg.b0b3cf3b3c0d.src: Pour the milk into a small steel saucepan.
seg.b0b3cf3b3c0d.t: এটা সৰু ষ্টীলৰ চচপেনত গাখীৰ ঢালক।
seg.b0b3cf3b3c0d.back: Pour the milk into a small steel saucepan.

seg.94d57531a741.src: Add the turmeric and pepper (and the cardamom, if using) and stir until no specks of turmeric float on top. They mix in more evenly before the milk is heated.
seg.94d57531a741.t: হালধি আৰু জালুক দিয়ক (ইলাচি দিলে সেইটোও) আৰু লৰাওক, যেতিয়ালৈকে ওপৰত হালধিৰ এটাও কণা ওপঙি নাথাকে। গাখীৰ গৰম কৰাৰ আগতে দিলে এইবোৰ অধিক সমানে মিহলি যায়।
seg.94d57531a741.back: Add the turmeric and black pepper (and cardamom too if adding it) and stir, until not even one particle of turmeric floats on top. If added before heating the milk, these mix more evenly.

seg.9da3932c6508.src: Set the pan on medium-low heat. Warm the milk with the turmeric and pepper; simmer 2 minutes. Once small bubbles appear around the edge, turn the heat to low and let it bubble gently.
seg.9da3932c6508.t: চচপেনটো মধ্যমীয়া-কম জুইত বহুৱাওক। হালধি আৰু জালুকৰ সৈতে গাখীৰ গৰম কৰক; 2 মিনিট লাহে লাহে উতলাওক। কাষত সৰু সৰু ফোঁহা দেখা দিলে জুই কমাই দিয়ক আৰু লাহে লাহে উতলিবলৈ দিয়ক।
seg.9da3932c6508.back: Set the saucepan on medium-low heat. Heat the milk with the turmeric and black pepper; boil slowly for 2 minutes. When small bubbles appear at the edge, lower the heat and let it boil slowly.

seg.c66cb9336ef5.src: Stir now and then and keep an eye on the pan, as milk rises fast once it boils. If it starts to climb, lift the pan off the heat for a few seconds.
seg.c66cb9336ef5.t: মাজে মাজে লৰাওক আৰু চচপেনটোৰ ওপৰত চকু ৰাখক, কিয়নো উতলিবলৈ ধৰিলে গাখীৰ বৰ সোনকালে উফৰি উঠে। ওপৰলৈ উঠিবলৈ ধৰিলে কেই ছেকেণ্ডমানৰ বাবে চচপেনটো জুইৰ পৰা তুলি লওক।
seg.c66cb9336ef5.back: Stir now and then and keep an eye on the saucepan, because once it starts boiling the milk boils over very quickly. If it starts to rise, lift the saucepan off the heat for a few seconds.

seg.b567bc0c93c9.src: It is ready when the milk is an even golden yellow and the raw smell of turmeric has gone.
seg.b567bc0c93c9.t: গাখীৰৰ ৰং সমানে সোণালী হালধীয়া হ’লে আৰু হালধিৰ কেঁচা গোন্ধ গুচি গ’লে সাজু।
seg.b567bc0c93c9.back: It is ready when the milk's colour is evenly golden yellow and the raw smell of the turmeric has gone.

seg.6e16c50d7c2a.src: Switch off and wait a minute. The milk drops just below the boil, so the jaggery will not split it.
seg.6e16c50d7c2a.t: জুই বন্ধ কৰি এক মিনিট অপেক্ষা কৰক। গাখীৰৰ উতলা মাত্ৰ থমে, গতিকে গুড় দিলে গাখীৰ নাফাটে।
seg.6e16c50d7c2a.back: Turn off the heat and wait one minute. The milk's boiling just stops, so when the jaggery is added the milk will not split.

seg.aa0d1bcf6802.src: For a smooth cup, pour the milk through a fine sieve into a tumbler or mug.
seg.aa0d1bcf6802.t: মসৃণ কাপৰ বাবে মিহি চেকনিৰে গাখীৰ টাম্বলাৰ বা মগত চেকি লওক।
seg.aa0d1bcf6802.back: For a smooth cup, strain the milk through a fine strainer into a tumbler or mug.

seg.862cac523844.src: Stir in the jaggery and serve warm. Stir for 20–30 seconds, until it dissolves, and taste for sweetness.
seg.862cac523844.t: গুড় লৰাই মিহলাই গৰমে গৰমে দিয়ক। 20–30 ছেকেণ্ড লৰাওক, যেতিয়ালৈকে গলি নাযায়, আৰু মিঠা চাখি চাওক।
seg.862cac523844.back: Stir in the jaggery and serve hot. Stir for 20–30 seconds, until it melts, and taste the sweetness.

seg.1d9b9ec736a8.src: Strain through a fine sieve if you like it smooth.
seg.1d9b9ec736a8.t: মসৃণ ভাল পালে মিহি চেকনিৰে চেকি লওক।
seg.1d9b9ec736a8.back: If you like it smooth, strain it through a fine strainer.

seg.018366193ef3.src: Add the jaggery only after switching off; jaggery stirred into boiling milk can split it.
seg.018366193ef3.t: গুড় কেৱল জুই বন্ধ কৰাৰ পিছতহে দিয়ক; উতলি থকা গাখীৰত গুড় মিহলালে গাখীৰ ফাটি যাব পাৰে।
seg.018366193ef3.back: Add the jaggery only after turning off the heat; if jaggery is mixed into boiling milk, the milk can split.

seg.0e783ba83473.src: Use a steel pan and spoon; turmeric stains plastic and wood.
seg.0e783ba83473.t: ষ্টীলৰ চচপেন আৰু চামুচ লওক; হালধিয়ে প্লাষ্টিক আৰু কাঠত দাগ বহুৱায়।
seg.0e783ba83473.back: Take a steel saucepan and spoon; turmeric leaves stains on plastic and wood.

seg.dc2a0c79ccd5.src: Making more? Use the same amounts for each cup of milk.
seg.dc2a0c79ccd5.t: বেছিকৈ বনাব? প্ৰতি কাপ গাখীৰত একে পৰিমাণ দিয়ক।
seg.dc2a0c79ccd5.back: Will you make more? Add the same amount per cup of milk.

seg.485f68415013.src: Hill turmeric: use Hill Turmeric Powder (konda pasupu) in place of turmeric powder, in the same amount.
seg.485f68415013.t: পাহাৰী হালধি: হালধি গুড়িৰ সলনি একে পৰিমাণৰ পাহাৰী হালধি গুড়ি (কোণ্ডা পাচুপু) দিয়ক।
seg.485f68415013.back: Hill turmeric: instead of turmeric powder, add the same amount of hill turmeric powder (konda pasupu).

seg.01ec7a142032.src: Palm or cane jaggery: palm jaggery gives a deeper, slightly smoky sweetness; cane jaggery a lighter, caramel one.
seg.01ec7a142032.t: তালৰ বা কুঁহিয়াৰৰ গুড়: তালৰ গুড়ে মিঠা সোৱাদ গভীৰ, অলপ ধোঁৱাৰ দৰে কৰে; কুঁহিয়াৰৰ গুড়ে পাতল, কেৰামেলৰ দৰে।
seg.01ec7a142032.back: Palm or sugarcane jaggery: palm jaggery makes the sweet taste deep, a little smoke-like; sugarcane jaggery, light, caramel-like.

seg.15b67235d087.src: Milder cup: leave out the pepper and add a pinch of cardamom powder instead.
seg.15b67235d087.t: পাতল কাপৰ বাবে: জালুক বাদ দিয়ক আৰু তাৰ সলনি এচিমটি ইলাচি গুড়ি দিয়ক।
seg.15b67235d087.back: For a light cup: leave out the black pepper and add a pinch of cardamom powder instead.

seg.d80219c8a51f.src: Serve warm in a tumbler or mug, on a cool evening or after the Karthika Somavaram puja.
seg.d80219c8a51f.t: টাম্বলাৰ বা মগত গৰমে গৰমে দিয়ক, চেঁচা গধূলি বা কাৰ্তিক সোমবাৰৰ পূজাৰ পিছত।
seg.d80219c8a51f.back: Serve hot in a tumbler or mug, on a cold evening or after the Kartika Monday puja.

seg.ac04ffd1d51a.src: Make it as you need it and drink it warm. Reheating after the jaggery is in can split the milk.
seg.ac04ffd1d51a.t: যেতিয়া লাগে তেতিয়াহে বনাওক আৰু গৰম থাকোঁতেই খাওক। গুড় দিয়াৰ পিছত আকৌ গৰম কৰিলে গাখীৰ ফাটি যাব পাৰে।
seg.ac04ffd1d51a.back: Make it only when you need it and drink it while it is still hot. If heated again after adding jaggery, the milk can split.

seg.c758e61dd102.src: Why did my pasupu paalu curdle?
seg.c758e61dd102.t: মোৰ পাচুপু পালু ফাটি গ’ল কিয়?
seg.c758e61dd102.back: Why did my pasupu palu split?

seg.d5f9c6fb2e27.src: Jaggery stirred into milk that is still boiling can make it split. Switch off the heat, wait about a minute, then stir in the grated jaggery.
seg.d5f9c6fb2e27.t: উতলি থকা গাখীৰত গুড় মিহলালে গাখীৰ ফাটি যাব পাৰে। জুই বন্ধ কৰক, প্ৰায় এক মিনিট অপেক্ষা কৰক, তাৰ পিছত খুৰুচা গুড় লৰাই মিহলাওক।
seg.d5f9c6fb2e27.back: If jaggery is mixed into boiling milk, the milk can split. Turn off the heat, wait about one minute, then stir in the grated jaggery.

seg.df4dbdd3102b.src: How much turmeric should I use for one cup of milk?
seg.df4dbdd3102b.t: এক কাপ গাখীৰত কিমান হালধি দিম?
seg.df4dbdd3102b.back: How much turmeric should I add to one cup of milk?

seg.3ec50124bdd7.src: ¼ tsp turmeric powder for 1 cup (about 240 ml) of milk. More than that makes the taste sharp and earthy.
seg.3ec50124bdd7.t: 1 কাপ (প্ৰায় 240 ml) গাখীৰত ¼ চাহ চামুচ হালধি গুড়ি। তাতকৈ বেছি দিলে সোৱাদ কড়া আৰু মাটিৰ দৰে হৈ যায়।
seg.3ec50124bdd7.back: ¼ teaspoon of turmeric powder in 1 cup (about 240 ml) of milk. If you add more than that, the taste becomes strong and earthy.

seg.3dc4d1edd4f9.src: Can I skip the black pepper?
seg.3dc4d1edd4f9.back: Can the black pepper be left out?

seg.166b3a44e11d.src: Yes. The pepper adds a little heat to the taste; leave it out, or use a pinch of cardamom instead, for a milder cup.
seg.166b3a44e11d.t: পাৰে। জালুকে সোৱাদত অলপ জ্বলা আনে; পাতল কাপৰ বাবে বাদ দিয়ক, বা তাৰ সলনি এচিমটি ইলাচি দিয়ক।
seg.166b3a44e11d.back: You can. Black pepper brings a little pungent heat to the taste; for a light cup leave it out, or add a pinch of cardamom instead.

seg.2184adfd31b0.src: Should I use palm jaggery or cane jaggery?
seg.2184adfd31b0.t: তালৰ গুড় দিম নে কুঁহিয়াৰৰ গুড়?
seg.2184adfd31b0.back: Should I add palm jaggery or sugarcane jaggery?

seg.ef65c3a9d015.src: Either works, 1 tsp grated per cup. Palm jaggery tastes deeper and slightly smoky; cane jaggery is lighter and more like caramel.
seg.ef65c3a9d015.t: দুয়োটাই চলে, প্ৰতি কাপত 1 চাহ চামুচ খুৰুচা। তালৰ গুড়ৰ সোৱাদ গভীৰ, অলপ ধোঁৱাৰ দৰে; কুঁহিয়াৰৰ গুড় পাতল, কেৰামেলৰ দৰে।
seg.ef65c3a9d015.back: Both work, 1 teaspoon grated per cup. Palm jaggery's taste is deep, a little smoke-like; sugarcane jaggery is light, caramel-like.

seg.5094f960d9a4.src: Bellam in a Telugu kitchen usually means one of two things: cheruku bellam, made from sugarcane juice, or thati bellam, made from the sap of the palmyra palm. FSSAI treats them as two separate products, each with its own standard.
seg.5094f960d9a4.t: তেলুগু পাকঘৰত বেল্লাম বুলিলে সাধাৰণতে দুটাৰ এটাক বুজায়: কুঁহিয়াৰৰ ৰসৰ পৰা বনোৱা চেৰুকু বেল্লাম, নাইবা তাল গছৰ ৰসৰ পৰা বনোৱা তাটি বেল্লাম। FSSAI-এ এই দুটাক বেলেগ বেলেগ দুটা সামগ্ৰী হিচাপে লয়, প্ৰতিটোৰে নিজা মানদণ্ড আছে।
seg.5094f960d9a4.back: In the Telugu kitchen, saying bellam usually means one of two: cheruku bellam made from sugarcane juice, or tati bellam made from the sap of the palm tree. FSSAI takes these two as two separate products, each has its own standard.

seg.13fd9611c493.src: They can look alike in a lump, but they taste different and suit different dishes. Here is how to tell them apart, which to use where, and how to keep them. There is a full Telugu section further down.

seg.13fd9611c493.back: In lump form they may look the same, but the taste is different and they suit different curries/dishes. See here how to recognise them, which one to use where, and how to store them. Below there is a complete section in Telugu.

seg.70c115199d4c.src: Cane jaggery (cheruku bellam) is boiled-down sugarcane juice with a mellow, caramel sweetness: the one for payasam, pongal and chimmili. Palm jaggery (thati bellam) is boiled-down palmyra sap, darker and deeper in taste: a favourite in filter coffee and tea. You can swap one for the other gram for gram; start with a little less palm jaggery. Keep both in an airtight jar.
seg.70c115199d4c.t: কুঁহিয়াৰৰ গুড় (চেৰুকু বেল্লাম) হৈছে কুঁহিয়াৰৰ ৰস উতলাই ঘন কৰা, মিঠা সোৱাদ কোমল, কেৰামেলৰ দৰে: পায়স, পোংগল আৰু চিম্মিলিৰ বাবে এইটোৱেই। তালৰ গুড় (তাটি বেল্লাম) হৈছে তালৰ ৰস উতলাই ঘন কৰা, ৰং অধিক গাঢ়, সোৱাদ অধিক গভীৰ: ফিল্টাৰ কফি আৰু চাহত বহুতৰ প্ৰিয়। এটাৰ সলনি আনটো গ্ৰাম জুখি সমানে দিব পাৰে; তালৰ গুড় অলপ কমকৈ দি আৰম্ভ কৰক। দুয়োটা বতাহ নোসোমোৱা বটলত ৰাখক।
seg.70c115199d4c.back: Sugarcane jaggery (cheruku bellam) is sugarcane juice boiled and thickened, the sweet taste soft, caramel-like: this is the one for payas, pongal and chimmili. Palm jaggery (tati bellam) is palm sap boiled and thickened, the colour darker, the taste deeper: many people's favourite in filter coffee and tea. You can use one instead of the other in equal amounts measured in grams; start by adding a little less palm jaggery. Keep both in an airtight bottle.

seg.db3bddd4a4fc.src: Cane jaggery is made wherever sugarcane grows: the juice is pressed out of the cane and boiled down in open pans. In Andhra Pradesh, Anakapalli has the second largest jaggery market in India.
seg.db3bddd4a4fc.t: য’তেই কুঁহিয়াৰ খেতি হয়, তাতেই কুঁহিয়াৰৰ গুড় বনোৱা হয়: কুঁহিয়াৰ পেৰি ৰস উলিয়াই মুকলি কেৰাহীত উতলাই ঘন কৰা হয়। অন্ধ্ৰপ্ৰদেশৰ আনাকাপল্লীত আছে ভাৰতৰ দ্বিতীয় বৃহত্তম গুড়ৰ বজাৰ।
seg.db3bddd4a4fc.back: Wherever sugarcane is farmed, there sugarcane jaggery is made: sugarcane is pressed, the juice extracted and boiled and thickened in an open kadai. Anakapalli in Andhra Pradesh has India's second-largest jaggery market.

seg.31988f9e86fc.src: Palm jaggery is made from the sap of the palmyra palm, thati chettu in Telugu. The sap is called neera, or thati neera, and it is boiled down until it sets.
seg.31988f9e86fc.t: তালৰ গুড় বনোৱা হয় তাল গছৰ ৰসৰ পৰা, তেলুগুত এই গছক তাটি চেট্টু বোলে। এই ৰসক নীৰা, বা তাটি নীৰা বোলে, আৰু গোট নমৰালৈকে উতলাই ঘন কৰা হয়।
seg.31988f9e86fc.back: Palm jaggery is made from the sap of the palm tree; in Telugu this tree is called tati chettu. This sap is called neera, or tati neera, and it is boiled and thickened until it sets into a mass.

seg.46fffb385af6.back: Keep the weight the same. Palm jaggery's taste is stronger, so start by adding a little less and increase according to taste.

seg.8a98e07b6f1e.src: In milk, coffee or tea, add either jaggery after the milk is off the boil, so the milk does not split.
seg.8a98e07b6f1e.t: গাখীৰ, কফি বা চাহত যিটো গুড়েই দিয়ক, গাখীৰৰ উতলা থমাৰ পিছতহে দিয়ক, যাতে গাখীৰ ফাটি নাযায়।
seg.8a98e07b6f1e.back: Whichever jaggery you add to milk, coffee or tea, add it only after the milk's boiling stops, so that the milk does not split.

seg.5ea00ae441ac.back: Use a dry spoon or knife. Jaggery absorbs moisture from the air and becomes sticky.

seg.f7071649dddd.src: Yes. Karupatti is the Tamil name for jaggery made from palmyra sap. In Telugu it is thati bellam, and in Hindi taad ka gud.
seg.f7071649dddd.t: হয়। তালৰ ৰসৰ পৰা বনোৱা গুড়ৰ তামিল নাম কৰুপট্টি। তেলুগুত ইয়াক তাটি বেল্লাম বোলে, আৰু হিন্দীত তাড় কা গুড়।
seg.f7071649dddd.back: Yes. Karupatti is the Tamil name of jaggery made from palm sap. In Telugu it is called tati bellam, and in Hindi taad ka gud.

seg.a591ce90fac8.src: Is gud the same as jaggery?
seg.a591ce90fac8.back: Are gud and jaggery the same?

seg.9e04d6270c92.src: Yes. Gud, or gur, is the Hindi word for jaggery, and bellam is the Telugu one. On its own it usually means cane jaggery.
seg.9e04d6270c92.t: হয়। জেগাৰীৰ হিন্দী শব্দ গুড়, বা গুৰ, আৰু তেলুগু শব্দ বেল্লাম। কেৱল ‘গুড়’ বুলিলে সাধাৰণতে কুঁহিয়াৰৰ গুড়কে বুজায়।
seg.9e04d6270c92.back: Yes. The Hindi word for jaggery is gud, or gur, and the Telugu word is bellam. Saying just ‘gud’ usually means sugarcane jaggery.

seg.cc79285bfadd.src: It has taken in moisture from the air, which happens faster in humid weather. Move it to an airtight jar and use a dry spoon.
seg.cc79285bfadd.t: ই বতাহৰ পৰা আৰ্দ্ৰতা শুহি লৈছে, আৰু সেমেকা বতৰত এনে সোনকালে হয়। বতাহ নোসোমোৱা বটললৈ সলাই ৰাখক আৰু শুকান চামুচ ব্যৱহাৰ কৰক।
seg.cc79285bfadd.back: It has absorbed moisture from the air, and in damp weather this happens quickly. Move it into an airtight bottle and use a dry spoon.

seg.1bdcd09c5ca0.src: Can I use palm jaggery in payasam?
seg.1bdcd09c5ca0.back: Can palm jaggery be added to payas?

seg.8ba95d799ac9.src: Yes. It gives a darker colour and a deeper taste. Add it off the heat, as you would cane jaggery.

seg.abda31761e23.src: Plain answers to what buyers ask us, starting with how to check turmeric powder at home.
seg.abda31761e23.t: গ্ৰাহকে আমাক যি সোধে, তাৰ পোনপটীয়া উত্তৰ, আৰম্ভণিতে ঘৰতে হালধি গুড়ি কেনেকৈ পৰীক্ষা কৰিব।
seg.abda31761e23.back: Straight answers to what customers ask us, at the start how to test turmeric powder at home.

seg.2b6b229e651e.src: FSSAI's standard says turmeric powder must be free from added colouring matter, including lead chromate, and from foreign starch. Its testing manual lists what inspectors check turmeric for: added dyes such as metanil yellow, lead salts, and chalk powder.
seg.2b6b229e651e.t: FSSAI-ৰ মানদণ্ড অনুসৰি হালধি গুড়িত বাহিৰৰ পৰা মিহলোৱা কোনো ৰং থাকিব নালাগে, লেড ক্ৰ’মেটো নহয়, আৰু আন কোনো শ্বেতসাৰো থাকিব নালাগে। ইয়াৰ পৰীক্ষাৰ মেনুৱেলত লিখা আছে পৰিদৰ্শকসকলে হালধিত কি কি বিচাৰে: মেটানিল য়েল’ৰ দৰে মিহলোৱা ৰং, সীহৰ লৱণ, আৰু চকৰ গুড়ি।
seg.2b6b229e651e.back: According to the FSSAI standard, turmeric powder must not have any colour mixed in from outside, not lead chromate either, and must not have any other starch either. Its testing manual says what inspectors look for in turmeric: mixed-in colours like metanil yellow, lead salts, and chalk powder.

seg.b27088069a9d.src: Some of this you can check in your kitchen, and some only a lab can find. This guide covers both, plus two popular tests that do not work for turmeric. Try them on any turmeric you buy, ours included.
seg.b27088069a9d.t: ইয়াৰে কিছুমান আপুনি নিজৰ পাকঘৰতে চাব পাৰে, আৰু কিছুমান কেৱল লেবতহে ধৰা পৰে। এই গাইডত দুয়োটা আছে, লগতে এনে দুটা চলিত পৰীক্ষাৰ কথা যিবোৰ হালধিৰ ক্ষেত্ৰত কাম নকৰে। আপুনি যিকোনো হালধি কিনে, আমাৰটোকে ধৰি, তাত এইবোৰ কৰি চাওক।
seg.b27088069a9d.back: Some of this you can check in your own kitchen, and some are caught only in a lab. This guide has both, along with two common tests which do not work in the case of turmeric. Whatever turmeric you buy, ours included, try these on it.

seg.b74ab3f9bb3e.src: Two glasses of water after the turmeric check. Left: pale yellow water with the powder settled at the bottom. Right: strong yellow water with yellow trails running down from the powder.
seg.b74ab3f9bb3e.t: হালধিৰ পৰীক্ষাৰ পিছত দুটা গিলাচ পানী। বাওঁফালে: শেঁতা হালধীয়া পানী, গুড়ি তলিত থিতাপি লৈছে। সোঁফালে: গাঢ় হালধীয়া পানী, গুড়িৰ পৰা হালধীয়া ৰেখা তললৈ নামি গৈছে।
seg.b74ab3f9bb3e.back: Two glasses of water after the turmeric test. Left: pale yellow water, the powder has settled at the bottom. Right: deep yellow water, yellow streaks have gone down from the powder.

seg.c8b6eb5f9530.src: ⟦1⟧The water check⟦/1⟧Left: the powder has settled and the water is pale yellow. Right: strong yellow trails ran from the powder as it sank, and the water turned deep yellow. That one is worth a lab test.
seg.c8b6eb5f9530.t: ⟦1⟧পানীৰ পৰীক্ষা⟦/1⟧বাওঁফালে: গুড়ি থিতাপি লৈছে আৰু পানী শেঁতা হালধীয়া। সোঁফালে: গুড়ি ডুবি যাওঁতে তাৰ পৰা গাঢ় হালধীয়া ৰেখা নামিছিল, আৰু পানী গাঢ় হালধীয়া হৈ গ’ল। সেইটো লেবত পৰীক্ষা কৰোৱা উচিত।
seg.c8b6eb5f9530.back: ⟦1⟧The water test⟦/1⟧Left: the powder has settled and the water is pale yellow. Right: while the powder was sinking, deep yellow streaks came down from it, and the water turned deep yellow. That one should be tested in a lab.

seg.a7363cc3fa37.src: Sprinkle a teaspoon of turmeric on a glass of water and let it settle without stirring. Turmeric sinks and leaves the water pale yellow; water that turns strong yellow straight away points to added colour. This check cannot find lead chromate or chalk, so for a sure answer, use a food testing lab. Skip the iodine test: turmeric is starchy to begin with.
seg.a7363cc3fa37.t: এগিলাচ পানীৰ ওপৰত এচাহ চামুচ হালধি ছটিয়াই দিয়ক আৰু নলৰোৱাকৈ থিতাপি ল’বলৈ দিয়ক। হালধি ডুবি যায় আৰু পানী শেঁতা হালধীয়া হৈ থাকে; পানী লগে লগে গাঢ় হালধীয়া হৈ গ’লে বুজিব বাহিৰৰ পৰা ৰং মিহলোৱা থাকিব পাৰে। এই পৰীক্ষাত লেড ক্ৰ’মেট বা চক ধৰা নপৰে, গতিকে নিশ্চিত উত্তৰৰ বাবে খাদ্য পৰীক্ষাৰ লেবলৈ যাওক। আয়’ডিন পৰীক্ষা নকৰিব: হালধিত এনেয়েও শ্বেতসাৰ থাকে।
seg.a7363cc3fa37.back: Sprinkle one teaspoon of turmeric on top of a glass of water and let it settle without stirring. Turmeric sinks and the water stays pale yellow; if the water turns deep yellow immediately, understand that colour may have been mixed in from outside. This test does not catch lead chromate or chalk, so for a sure answer go to a food testing lab. Do not do the iodine test: turmeric contains starch anyway.

seg.9b20e15186d4.t: FSSAI-এ হালধিত কি কি পৰীক্ষা কৰে
seg.9b20e15186d4.back: What FSSAI tests for in turmeric

seg.34d6f989bfaf.src: Such as metanil yellow, which can make dull turmeric look brighter. FSSAI does not allow added colour in turmeric.
seg.34d6f989bfaf.t: যেনে মেটানিল য়েল', যিয়ে ম্লান হালধিক অধিক উজ্জ্বল দেখুৱায়। FSSAI-এ হালধিত বাহিৰৰ পৰা ৰং মিহলোৱাৰ অনুমতি নিদিয়ে।
seg.34d6f989bfaf.back: Such as metanil yellow, which makes dull turmeric look brighter. FSSAI does not give permission for mixing colour into turmeric from outside.

seg.042cabe54b01.src: Lead chromate and other lead salts
seg.042cabe54b01.t: লেড ক্ৰ’মেট আৰু আন সীহৰ লৱণ
seg.042cabe54b01.back: Lead chromate and other lead salts

seg.8310b11eab8b.src: Lead chromate is a yellow pigment used in paint. Stanford-led studies published in 2019 and 2024 found it in turmeric from parts of South Asia. FSSAI does not allow it in turmeric at all.
seg.8310b11eab8b.t: লেড ক্ৰ’মেট হৈছে ৰঙত ব্যৱহাৰ কৰা এবিধ হালধীয়া ৰঞ্জক। ষ্টেনফৰ্ডৰ নেতৃত্বত 2019 আৰু 2024 চনত প্ৰকাশিত অধ্যয়নত দক্ষিণ এছিয়াৰ কিছু অঞ্চলৰ হালধিত ইয়াক পোৱা গৈছিল। FSSAI-এ হালধিত ইয়াৰ অলপো অনুমতি নিদিয়ে।
seg.8310b11eab8b.back: Lead chromate is a kind of yellow pigment used in paints. In studies led by Stanford, published in 2019 and 2024, it was found in turmeric from some regions of South Asia. FSSAI does not give even a little permission for it in turmeric.

seg.4278e7c5416c.src: A cheap white powder that adds weight.
seg.4278e7c5416c.t: এবিধ সস্তীয়া বগা গুড়ি, যিয়ে ওজন বঢ়ায়।
seg.4278e7c5416c.back: A kind of cheap white powder, which increases the weight.

seg.5a8b446bbce0.src: Flour or starch from other crops. FSSAI's standard rules it out too.
seg.5a8b446bbce0.t: আন শস্যৰ আটা বা শ্বেতসাৰ। FSSAI-ৰ মানদণ্ডত এইটোও বাদ।
seg.5a8b446bbce0.back: Flour or starch of other grains. This too is excluded in the FSSAI standard.

seg.1b1af7f63ffd.src: Fill a clear glass with water at room temperature.
seg.1b1af7f63ffd.t: এটা স্বচ্ছ গিলাচত কোঠাৰ উষ্ণতাৰ পানী ভৰাওক।
seg.1b1af7f63ffd.back: Fill a clear glass with room-temperature water.

seg.653731f2ed6f.src: Sprinkle one level teaspoon of turmeric powder on top. Do not stir.
seg.653731f2ed6f.t: ওপৰত এক সমান চাহ চামুচ হালধি গুড়ি ছটিয়াই দিয়ক। নলৰাব।
seg.653731f2ed6f.back: Sprinkle one level teaspoon of turmeric powder on top. Do not stir.

seg.ea5b43cf8436.src: Watch the first minute as the powder sinks. Look for coloured trails running down from it.
seg.ea5b43cf8436.t: প্ৰথম এক মিনিট গুড়ি ডুবি যাওঁতে চাই থাকক। গুড়িৰ পৰা ৰঙীন ৰেখা তললৈ নামিছে নে নাই মন কৰক।
seg.ea5b43cf8436.back: For the first minute, keep watching while the powder sinks. Notice whether coloured streaks have come down from the powder or not.

seg.e37698aaa3fb.src: Leave it for 15 to 20 minutes. Then hold the glass against a white wall or a sheet of paper and look at the water above the settled powder.
seg.e37698aaa3fb.t: 15ৰ পৰা 20 মিনিট ৰাখি দিয়ক। তাৰ পিছত গিলাচটো বগা বেৰ বা এখিলা কাগজৰ সন্মুখত ধৰি থিতাপি লোৱা গুড়িৰ ওপৰৰ পানীখিনি চাওক।
seg.e37698aaa3fb.back: Leave it for 15 to 20 minutes. Then hold the glass in front of a white wall or a sheet of paper and look at the water above the settled powder.

seg.e8937cebf136.src: Pale yellow water, powder at the bottom
seg.e8937cebf136.back: Pale yellow water, powder at the bottom

seg.256ce5cf303d.src: Strong yellow trails, or deep yellow water within minutes
seg.256ce5cf303d.t: গাঢ় হালধীয়া ৰেখা, বা কেই মিনিটমানৰ ভিতৰত গাঢ় হালধীয়া পানী
seg.256ce5cf303d.back: Deep yellow streaks, or deep yellow water within a few minutes

seg.ce06c8148072.src: Possible added colour. Stop using that batch and get it tested.
seg.ce06c8148072.t: ৰং মিহলোৱা থাকিব পাৰে। সেই বেচটো ব্যৱহাৰ কৰা বন্ধ কৰক আৰু পৰীক্ষা কৰাওক।
seg.ce06c8148072.back: Colour may be mixed in. Stop using that batch and get it tested.

seg.53d9c5db264d.src: ⟦1⟧Why it works.⟦/1⟧ Turmeric's own yellow, curcumin, hardly dissolves in water, so the powder sinks and only tints the water. Dyes such as metanil yellow dissolve easily and colour the water fast.
seg.53d9c5db264d.t: ⟦1⟧কিয় কাম কৰে।⟦/1⟧ হালধিৰ নিজা হালধীয়া ৰং, কাৰকিউমিন, পানীত প্ৰায় গলি নাযায়, গতিকে গুড়ি ডুবি যায় আৰু পানীত কেৱল পাতল ৰং ধৰে। মেটানিল য়েল’ৰ দৰে ৰং সহজে গলি যায় আৰু সোনকালে পানী ৰঙীন কৰে।
seg.53d9c5db264d.back: ⟦1⟧Why it works.⟦/1⟧ Turmeric's own yellow colour, curcumin, hardly dissolves in water, so the powder sinks and the water takes only a light colour. Colours like metanil yellow dissolve easily and quickly colour the water.

seg.af4442c6e910.src: ⟦1⟧What it misses.⟦/1⟧ Lead chromate and chalk do not dissolve in water either, so turmeric mixed with them can pass this check. Only a lab test can rule them out.
seg.af4442c6e910.t: ⟦1⟧কি ধৰা নপৰে।⟦/1⟧ লেড ক্ৰ’মেট আৰু চকো পানীত গলি নাযায়, গতিকে এইবোৰ মিহলোৱা হালধিয়েও এই পৰীক্ষাত পাৰ পাই যাব পাৰে। কেৱল লেবৰ পৰীক্ষাইহে এইবোৰ আছে নে নাই ক’ব পাৰে।
seg.af4442c6e910.back: ⟦1⟧What it does not catch.⟦/1⟧ Lead chromate and chalk also do not dissolve in water, so turmeric mixed with these can also pass this test. Only a lab test can tell whether these are present or not.

seg.a8b61850b87d.src: Very fine powder can keep the water cloudy for a while. Cloudy is fine; a clear, strong yellow is what to look for.
seg.a8b61850b87d.t: অতি মিহি গুড়িত পানী কিছু সময় ঘোলা হৈ থাকিব পাৰে। ঘোলা হ’লে অসুবিধা নাই; চাবলগীয়া কথাটো হ’ল স্বচ্ছ, গাঢ় হালধীয়া পানী।
seg.a8b61850b87d.back: With very fine powder the water may stay cloudy for some time. Cloudiness is no problem; the thing to look at is clear, deep yellow water.

seg.c3455d1f4c96.src: Check 2: if you buy whole turmeric
seg.c3455d1f4c96.back: Test 2: if you buy whole turmeric

seg.3d4e366bb488.src: Snap a finger of dried turmeric in half. Turmeric is yellow-orange right through, so the inside should look much like the outside. A bright yellow skin over a pale or dull core can mean colour was added to the surface. Ask the seller about it, or get it tested.
seg.3d4e366bb488.t: এডাল শুকান হালধি মাজৰ পৰা ভাঙক। হালধি ভিতৰলৈকে হালধীয়া-কমলা, গতিকে ভিতৰখন বাহিৰৰ দৰেই দেখা হ’ব লাগে। শেঁতা বা ম্লান ভিতৰৰ ওপৰত উজ্জ্বল হালধীয়া বাকলিৰ অৰ্থ হ’ব পাৰে ওপৰত ৰং সনা হৈছে। বিক্ৰেতাক সোধক, বা পৰীক্ষা কৰাওক।
seg.3d4e366bb488.back: Break a dry piece (stick) of turmeric from the middle. Turmeric is yellow-orange right through to the inside, so the inside should look the same as the outside. A bright yellow skin over a pale or dull inside can mean colour has been smeared on top. Ask the seller, or get it tested.

seg.c62fa16e1d5f.back: The two tests you should not do

seg.4c4dc95561d2.src: Iodine turns blue-black when it meets starch, and it is often suggested for spotting flour in turmeric. But turmeric is starchy itself, so it turns blue-black either way. That is why FSSAI's own manual uses the iodine test for powdered spices other than turmeric.
seg.4c4dc95561d2.t: আয়’ডিন শ্বেতসাৰৰ সংস্পৰ্শলৈ আহিলে নীলা-ক’লা হৈ যায়, আৰু হালধিত আটা আছে নে নাই ধৰিবলৈ বহুতে ইয়াক কৰিবলৈ কয়। কিন্তু হালধিত নিজেই শ্বেতসাৰ থাকে, গতিকে যিকোনো অৱস্থাতে নীলা-ক’লা হৈ যায়। সেইবাবেই FSSAI-ৰ নিজা মেনুৱেলত আয়’ডিন পৰীক্ষা হালধিৰ বাহিৰে আন মছলাৰ গুড়িৰ বাবে ৰখা হৈছে।
seg.4c4dc95561d2.back: Iodine turns blue-black when it comes into contact with starch, and many people say to do this to catch whether there is flour in turmeric. But turmeric itself contains starch, so it turns blue-black in any condition. That is why in FSSAI's own manual the iodine test is kept for spice powders other than turmeric.

seg.fc16ff8016e3.src: FSSAI's tests for lead, metanil yellow and chalk in turmeric use concentrated hydrochloric or sulphuric acid. These acids burn skin and eyes. They belong in a lab, not a kitchen.
seg.fc16ff8016e3.t: হালধিত সীহ, মেটানিল য়েল' আৰু চক ধৰিবলৈ FSSAI-ৰ পৰীক্ষাত গাঢ় হাইড্ৰ’ক্ল’ৰিক বা ছালফিউৰিক এচিড লাগে। এই এচিডে ছাল আৰু চকু পুৰি পেলায়। এইবোৰৰ ঠাই লেবত, পাকঘৰত নহয়।
seg.fc16ff8016e3.back: FSSAI's tests to catch lead, metanil yellow and chalk in turmeric need concentrated hydrochloric or sulphuric acid. This acid burns skin and eyes. Their place is in a lab, not in the kitchen.

seg.1dd87aa7bdc7.src: For a sure answer: a food testing lab
seg.1dd87aa7bdc7.t: নিশ্চিত উত্তৰৰ বাবে: খাদ্য পৰীক্ষাৰ লেব
seg.1dd87aa7bdc7.back: For a sure answer: a food testing lab

seg.1883beca4d73.src: A NABL-accredited food testing lab can test turmeric for lead and for added colours. Ask the lab how much sample it needs, keep the powder in its sealed pack or a clean sealed bag, and note the batch number printed on the pack. FSSAI publishes a list of notified food testing labs on its website.
seg.1883beca4d73.t: NABL-স্বীকৃত খাদ্য পৰীক্ষাৰ লেবে হালধিত সীহ আৰু মিহলোৱা ৰং পৰীক্ষা কৰিব পাৰে। লেবক সোধক কিমান নমুনা লাগিব, গুড়িখিনি তাৰ ছীল কৰা পেকেটত বা এটা পৰিষ্কাৰ ছীল কৰা বেগত ৰাখক, আৰু পেকেটত ছপা বেচ নম্বৰটো লিখি ৰাখক। FSSAI-এ নিজৰ ৱেবছাইটত জাননী দিয়া খাদ্য পৰীক্ষাৰ লেবৰ তালিকা প্ৰকাশ কৰে।
seg.1883beca4d73.back: An NABL-accredited food testing lab can test turmeric for lead and mixed-in colours. Ask the lab how much sample will be needed, keep the powder in its sealed packet or a clean sealed bag, and note down the batch number printed on the packet. FSSAI publishes on its website a list of food testing labs it has given notice of (notified).

seg.456379c75c24.src: Read the pack before you buy

seg.ff7951e2f36b.src: An FSSAI licence or registration number. You can look it up on FSSAI's FoSCoS website.
seg.ff7951e2f36b.t: এটা FSSAI লাইচেন্স বা পঞ্জীয়ন নম্বৰ। FSSAI-ৰ FoSCoS ৱেবছাইটত ইয়াক বিচাৰি চাব পাৰে।
seg.ff7951e2f36b.back: An FSSAI licence or registration number. You can look it up on FSSAI's FoSCoS website.

seg.476e4849c1d8.src: The name and address of whoever made or packed it.
seg.476e4849c1d8.t: যিয়ে বনাইছে বা পেক কৰিছে, তেওঁৰ নাম আৰু ঠিকনা।
seg.476e4849c1d8.back: The name and address of the one who made or packed it.

seg.beee8eda6466.src: Net quantity, MRP, a batch or lot number, and a best-before date.
seg.beee8eda6466.t: নেট পৰিমাণ, MRP, বেচ বা লট নম্বৰ, আৰু বেষ্ট-বিফ’ৰ তাৰিখ।
seg.beee8eda6466.back: Net quantity, MRP, batch or lot number, and best-before date.

seg.f9270fd96202.src: Where it was grown. Turmeric from different regions differs in colour, so a named region helps you compare like with like.
seg.f9270fd96202.t: ক’ত খেতি কৰা হৈছিল। বেলেগ বেলেগ অঞ্চলৰ হালধিৰ ৰং বেলেগ হয়, গতিকে অঞ্চলৰ নাম লিখা থাকিলে একে ধৰণৰ বস্তুৰ মাজত তুলনা কৰাত সুবিধা হয়।
seg.f9270fd96202.back: Where it was farmed. Turmeric from different regions differs in colour, so if the region's name is written, it helps in comparing between the same kind of things.

seg.7cdc58c0c7e8.src: Keep the pack zipped shut, or move the powder to a dry, airtight jar.
seg.7cdc58c0c7e8.t: পেকেটৰ জিপ বন্ধ কৰি ৰাখক, বা গুড়িখিনি এটা শুকান, বতাহ নোসোমোৱা বটললৈ সলাই ৰাখক।
seg.7cdc58c0c7e8.back: Keep the packet's zip closed, or move the powder into a dry, airtight bottle.

seg.bb4d61f86b55.src: Use a dry spoon. A damp spoon is what makes turmeric lumpy.
seg.bb4d61f86b55.t: শুকান চামুচ ব্যৱহাৰ কৰক। তিতা চামুচৰ বাবেই হালধি দলা বান্ধে।
seg.bb4d61f86b55.back: Use a dry spoon. It is because of a wet spoon that turmeric forms lumps.

seg.a92c022ff52e.src: Keep it out of direct sunlight, which fades the colour.
seg.a92c022ff52e.t: পোনপটীয়া ৰ’দৰ পৰা আঁতৰাই ৰাখক, ৰ’দে ৰং শেঁতা কৰি দিয়ে।
seg.a92c022ff52e.back: Keep it away from direct sunlight; sunlight makes the colour pale.

seg.6911ce63edde.src: Is very bright yellow turmeric a bad sign?
seg.6911ce63edde.t: অতি উজ্জ্বল হালধীয়া হালধি বেয়া লক্ষণ নেকি?
seg.6911ce63edde.back: Is very bright yellow turmeric a bad sign?

seg.a0ce62cee740.src: Not by itself. Colour changes with the variety, where it was grown and how it was dried and ground, so turmerics differ a lot. What matters is colour that leaves the powder too easily, as in the water check.
seg.a0ce62cee740.t: কেৱল সেইটোৱে নহয়। ৰং সলনি হয় জাত অনুসৰি, ক’ত খেতি কৰা হৈছিল আৰু কেনেকৈ শুকুৱাই গুড়ি কৰা হৈছিল তাৰ ওপৰত, গতিকে হালধিৰ মাজত বহুত পাৰ্থক্য থাকে। চাবলগীয়া কথা হ’ল গুড়িৰ পৰা অতি সহজে ৰং ওলাই যায় নে নাই, যেনে পানীৰ পৰীক্ষাত দেখা যায়।
seg.a0ce62cee740.back: Not by that alone. Colour changes according to the variety, where it was farmed and how it was dried and powdered, so there is a lot of difference among turmerics. The thing to look at is whether colour comes out of the powder very easily or not, as seen in the water test.

seg.e8cc5edbb092.src: Can the water check show that turmeric has no lead?
seg.e8cc5edbb092.t: পানীৰ পৰীক্ষাই হালধিত সীহ নাই বুলি দেখুৱাব পাৰেনে?
seg.e8cc5edbb092.back: Can the water test show that there is no lead in turmeric?

seg.37eb38df9ce8.src: No. Lead chromate does not dissolve in water, so the water check cannot see it. Only a lab test can.
seg.37eb38df9ce8.t: নোৱাৰে। লেড ক্ৰ’মেট পানীত গলি নাযায়, গতিকে পানীৰ পৰীক্ষাত ই ধৰা নপৰে। কেৱল লেবৰ পৰীক্ষাতহে পৰে।
seg.37eb38df9ce8.back: It cannot. Lead chromate does not dissolve in water, so it is not caught in the water test. Only in a lab test is it caught.

seg.2b76cd3e665b.src: Moisture. A wet spoon or an open pack lets the powder take in water. Break the lumps with a dry spoon and keep the pack sealed.
seg.2b76cd3e665b.t: আৰ্দ্ৰতা। তিতা চামুচ বা খোলা পেকেটৰ বাবে গুড়িয়ে পানী শুহি লয়। শুকান চামুচেৰে দলাবোৰ ভাঙি দিয়ক আৰু পেকেট বন্ধ কৰি ৰাখক।
seg.2b76cd3e665b.back: Moisture. Because of a wet spoon or an open packet, the powder absorbs water. Break up the lumps with a dry spoon and keep the packet closed.

seg.87fe2929801d.src: What should I do if a check looks wrong?
seg.87fe2929801d.t: কোনো পৰীক্ষাত গণ্ডগোল যেন লাগিলে কি কৰিম?
seg.87fe2929801d.back: What should I do if something seems wrong in any test?

seg.e83aba6cc6df.src: Stop using that batch, keep the pack, and contact the seller with the batch number. You can also report it to FSSAI through its Food Safety Connect app. If it is ours, WhatsApp us a photo of the pack and the glass.
seg.e83aba6cc6df.t: সেই বেচটো ব্যৱহাৰ কৰা বন্ধ কৰক, পেকেটটো ৰাখি থওক, আৰু বেচ নম্বৰৰ সৈতে বিক্ৰেতাৰ লগত যোগাযোগ কৰক। FSSAI-ৰ Food Safety Connect এপতো জনাব পাৰে। আমাৰ হ’লে পেকেট আৰু গিলাচৰ এখন ফটো আমাক WhatsApp কৰক।
seg.e83aba6cc6df.back: Stop using that batch, keep the packet, and contact the seller with the batch number. You can also report it on FSSAI's Food Safety Connect app. If it is ours, WhatsApp us a photo of the packet and the glass.
